findings.detail: The system records per officer: "F.I.Sh." (full name), "tabel raqami" (personnel/payroll number = natural key), "bo'linma" (unit) and "xizmat holati" (service status). These four are the mandatory columns of the officer table and of the officer card in the admin panel.

A cabinet is assigned only to an officer satisfying ALL of: (1) "xizmat quroli rasmiy biriktirilgan" (service weapon officially assigned), (2) "qurolni saqlash va olib yurishga vakolati mavjud" (authority to keep/carry), (3) "maxsus tayyorgarlikdan o'tgan" (special training passed), (4) "davriy professional yaroqlilik tekshiruvidan o'tgan" (periodic professional fitness check passed), (5) "rahbar buyrug'i bilan qurol olish huquqi berilgan" (right granted by commander's order). Model as 5 dated/expiring qualification records (training date, fitness-check date + validity, order number/date), and the cabinet-assignment action must validate all five.

findings.topic: Authorization is external, system only verifies
findings.detail: "HUQUQIY TAMOYIL": the weapon right is created by the organisation head's decision, the permit and completed training; the Smart cabinet "bu vakolatni yaratmaydi — faqat mavjud vakolatni texnik jihatdan tekshiradi va qayd etadi". Data consequence: store the commander order (buyruq raqami/sanasi) and permit references as evidence documents, not as something the admin panel grants on its own.

"Kirish huquqi" is defined as "Xizmat kartasi + biometrika/PIN + xizmat holati": a service card, a biometric or PIN factor, and an active service status. Service status is therefore a gating attribute on the officer, and card and biometric/PIN are separate credential records.

At each access the system checks "xizmat navbati, lavozim va amaldagi ruxsat" (duty shift, position, current permit). Officer needs a "lavozim" attribute, a link to a duty roster/shift record, and a current permit with validity window.

"Shkaf raqami, xodim tabel raqami va jihoz identifikatorlari yagona elektron profilga bog'lanadi" — cabinet number, officer tabel number and item identifiers are linked into one profile. This is the central Assignment aggregate: Officer 1—1 Cabinet 1—N Items.

findings.topic: One officer – one cabinet – one duty location
findings.detail: Principle "Bir xodim — bir shkaf": each cabinet is bound to exactly one officially authorised officer profile; binding table says Shkaf → "Bitta xodim va bitta xizmat joyiga" (one officer and one duty location). Cabinet assignment record therefore carries officer_id + location_id, uniqueness on active officer and active cabinet.
findings.source: 01 'Loyiha konsepsiyasi' table row 'Bir xodim — bir shkaf'; §2.3 row 'Shkaf'; §2.6 'YAKUNIY FORMULA'

findings.detail: "Navbatchi yoki komandir" manages "vaqtinchalik vakolat" (temporary authority) and emergency opening. Permissions must support time-bounded grants (valid_from/valid_to, granted_by, reason).

International reference Traka/ASSA ABLOY: "vaqt bo'yicha vakolat" (time-window authorisation), inventory state and audit journal — adopted as pattern; permissions carry schedule windows, not only booleans.

For high-risk operations: "yuqori xavfli operatsiyada ikki xodim tasdig'i" and for emergency opening "zarur holatda ikki mas'ul shaxs tasdig'i". Event record needs approver_1 and approver_2 identity fields and a policy flag on the operation type.

The 3.5" display shows "holat, ko'rsatmalar ... xodim ID" and the mock screen prints 'Ruxsat · Xodim #01'. A short display label for the officer is shown at the terminal; real key remains tabel raqami (01).

First customer: O'zbekiston Respublikasi IIV and its "hududiy hamda funksional bo'linmalari": tuman va shahar ichki ishlar bo'limlari; patrul-post xizmati; qo'riqlash va tezkor bo'linmalar; maxsus operatsion bo'linmalar; qurol saqlanadigan navbatchilik qismlari; o'quv va tayyorgarlik markazlari. Later: Milliy gvardiya, bojxona, harbiy qismlar. Unit entity needs a type/category field and organisation (agency) parent.

Recommended architecture defines 5 levels: "Har bir shkaf" → "Har 10–20 shkaf" (one Face ID terminal, screen, shared comms/control module) → "Har bir qurolxona" (local controller, UPS, event cache, network gateway) → "Tashkilot serveri" (central DB, permissions, audit, dashboard) → "Hudud/respublika" (aggregated monitoring within authority). Data hierarchy: Region → Organisation/Unit → Armory (qurolxona) → TerminalGroup → Cabinet.

findings.topic: Region and unit dimensions on dashboard
findings.detail: Dashboard must show "hudud va bo'linmalar bo'yicha holat" — status by territory (viloyat) and by unit. Region and unit are first-class filter dimensions on every aggregate.

findings.topic: Armory as legal entity with responsible person
findings.detail: Under O'RQ-550: weapons of legal entities are kept in a specially equipped, technically reinforced "qurolxona" with guard/fire alarm; "Qurolxona va saqlash joyi ruxsat berish jarayonida ko'rsatiladi" (armory named in the permit) and "Qurol va o'q-dorining saqlanishi, berilishi, qabul qilinishi va hisobi uchun mas'ul shaxs tayinlanadi" (an accountable person is appointed). Armory record: name, address, permit reference, responsible officer (FK to officer with role Qurolxona mas'uli), alarm-system presence.

Customer must specify per site: "Qurolxona o'lchami, elektr, tarmoq, harorat, namlik va o'rnatish sharoiti". Optional armory attributes: room dimensions, power, network, temperature/humidity envelope, install notes.
20 cabinets × 400 mm = 8 m; installed 10 per wall on two walls with 1.2–1.5 m service aisle. Cabinet needs a position attribute (wall/row + index) so the admin panel can draw an armory map.
System records per cabinet: "Raqami" (number), "manzili" (address/location), "texnik holati" (technical state).

Qurolxona mas'uli "shkafni biriktiradi va bloklaydi" (assigns and blocks a cabinet); dashboard lists "nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar". Scale formula adds "5–10% zaxira" cabinets. Cabinet state enum must include at least: assigned/active, reserve (unassigned), blocked, faulty (nosoz).

Adopted gabarit: weapon section 2000 × 400 × 600 mm; complex with electronics module 2000 × 600 × 600 mm (module 150–200 mm). A cabinet model/version attribute distinguishes 'with module' vs 'without module' units (only some cabinets carry the shared terminal).
findings.source: 01 §1.1 'Tavsiya etiladigan yakuniy o'lchamlar' + box 'QABUL QILINGAN GABARIT'

findings.detail: Five zones: "Pastki zona" 0–1150 mm (AK-74 va taktik sumka); "O'rta zona" 1150–1450 (o'q-dori qutisi yoki bronjilet); "Yuqori-o'rta zona" 1450–1700 (PM, magazinlar, kishan va kichik jihozlar); "Yuqori zona" 1700–1950 (dubulg'a va gaz niqobi); "Texnik bo'shliq" 1950–2000 (kabel, LED, datchiklar). Shelves are removable/adjustable "turli lavozim va komplektatsiyadagi xodimlar uchun". Model: Slot entity per cabinet (zone, height range, expected item type, sensor ids), instantiated from a configurable template so different positions/kits use one base body.

Concept places: AK-74 upright in lower bay (z 180–1293, centre x −273); taktik sumka on floor (450×300×195); kamar + PM koburasi + kishan on hook plate on right liner (z 880–1270); bronjilet hanger rod Ø20 at z 1230; shelf 1293: closed steel o'q-dori qutisi 240×200×130 under lockable strap + 2 o'q pachkasi 5,45×39; shelf 1553: PM box 200×160×60 (PM + 2 magazines, separate electronic lock), AK magazine slot for 4 (30 mm pitch, lockable lid), kichik jihozlar qutisi 160×120×60 (fonar, pichoq, tibbiy paket); shelf 1812: dubulg'a 6B47 in ring cradle, gaz niqobi sumkasi behind. Use as default slot instances; zone boundaries from 01 §1.2 govern.
findings.source: 02 §5.3 'Jihozlar joylashuvi (1 askar)'; 03 <aside> 'Jihozlar (1 askar)'; 03 JS addCab() roles

findings.detail: Required sensors: "Eshik holati, urilish va buzishga urinish datchiklari" (door state, impact, tamper); plus "Qurol va o'q-dori holati mustaqil nazorat qilinadi" (weapon and ammo state monitored independently). Sensor entity per cabinet: type ∈ {door, impact, tamper, weapon_presence, ammo_weight, ...}, last value, last seen.
findings.source: 01 §1.4 'Konstruksiya uchun boshlang'ich talablar'; §4.5 'eshik va buzishga urinish datchiklari'

findings.detail: "Bitta tashqi eshik; elektron qulf va favqulodda mexanik qulf"; "mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi" — use of the mechanical key is a separately recorded event type. Cabinet has main door lock (fail-secure) and a mechanical-key-used sensor/event.

Beyond the door lock, the concept has: "Stvol qulfi — solenoidli planka" on the AK barrel clamp; "PM to'pponcha qutisi ... alohida elektron qulf"; "O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari ... +x oyoqda solenoid (PM qutisi ruxsati)"; "AK magazin uyasi ... qulflanadigan qopqoq". Lock actuator entity per cabinet: kind ∈ {door, rifle_clamp, pistol_box, ammo_strap, magazine_lid}, state, linked permission.
findings.source: 03 <aside> 'Beshik va qisqich', 'Xavfsizlik'; 03 JS addCab roles 'Stvol qulfi', 'PM to'pponcha qutisi', 'O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari', 'AK magazin uyasi'; 02 §6

findings.topic: Two separate weapon permissions: rifle / pistol
findings.detail: "PM qutisi va stvol qulfi — ikkita alohida ruxsat (avtomat / to'pponcha)" and 02: "avtomat va PM qutisi uchun ikkita alohida ruxsat". The ammo strap solenoid is tied to the pistol-box permission. Permission model must have at least two item-class grants per officer: AVTOMAT (rifle clamp) and TO'PPONCHA (PM box + ammo box), each independently grantable/revocable and logged.
findings.source: 03 <aside> 'Beshik va qisqich' (last clause); 03 JS addCab role 'O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari ... (PM qutisi ruxsati)'; 02 §5.4 'Ssenariy'

findings.detail: Rifle may be removed only with door ≥ 90° open and clamp unlocked; "Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi"; door closing auto-locks ("eshik yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi", driven by the door-closed sensor). Cabinet runtime state needs: door_open, rifle_present, clamp_locked, door_locked.

Auth states in the viewer: idle → face → finger → ok → open → lock. Screen texts: 'Yuzingizni kameraga qarating', 'Yuz tanilmoqda…', 'Barmoq izini beshikka qo'ying', 'Ruxsat · Xodim #01 / Chapga qadam qo'ying, eshikni oching', 'Eshiklar ochiq / Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi', 'Qulflandi'. Status LED: "ko'k — kutish, sariq — barmoq, yashil — ruxsat, qizil — qulf". Admin panel live view can show per-cabinet session state with these values (extend with 'card' and 'pin' steps per 01 §4.2).
"Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat" (backup power on mains loss) and alarm type "quvvat uzilishi". Track per cabinet/terminal: mains_ok, battery_level, on_battery_since.

"Har bir shkaf: Elektron qulf, RFID/ID, holat datchiklari va ESP32/STM32 sinfidagi kontroller"; §3.3: each cabinet gets "qulf, identifikator, datchiklar va arzon mahalliy kontroller". Controller entity: hardware id/MAC, firmware version, cabinet FK, last heartbeat, online/offline.

"10–20 ta shkafga bitta umumiy Face ID terminali, lokal kontroller va aloqa moduli"; §4.7 "Har 10–20 shkaf: Bitta Face ID terminali, ekran va umumiy aloqa/boshqaruv moduli". Terminal entity: id, armory FK, served cabinets (1→N), reader capabilities, firmware, state.

"Har bir qurolxona: Lokal kontroller, UPS, hodisalar keshi va tarmoq shlyuzi" — a local server per armory that caches events and bridges the network. Entity: armory_controller (Raspberry Pi per proposed defaults): id, armory FK, ups_state, last_sync_at, pending_event_count, gateway address.

Full-height module 200×623×2056 contains: SBC controller + face-recognition processor, 24 V/150 W PSU, DIN DC-UPS, LiFePO4 12.8 V 20 Ah (≈5 h autonomy), lock relays with TVS, door sensors, LTE router with external SMA antenna, IP54 sealed body, membrane vent, 30–50 W thermostatic heater below 5 °C, tamper sensors on service hatches. Telemetry attributes worth modelling on the terminal/controller: battery_voltage/level, on_ups, lte_signal, hatch_tamper, internal_temperature. (01 supersedes the per-cabinet module topology with a shared terminal, but the telemetry fields remain valid.)
findings.source: 02 §5.4 'Elektronika moduli va o'quvchi'; 03 <aside> 'Ichki joy', 'Xizmat kirishi', 'Xavfsizlik', 'Muhit', 'Aloqa va EMC'; 03 JS addBox() roles

findings.detail: Reader module 120×260×14: IR camera Ø10, RGB camera Ø8, IR illuminator Ø6 (100×44 window, 11° tilt, 1466 mm height); 3.5" display 74×56 at ≈1390 mm; capacitive fingerprint sensor Ø24 with LED ring in 35° cradle at ≈1290 mm; 60×3 mm status LED bar. Device registry: reader id, type flags {face, fingerprint, display, card?}, mount height, firmware.

"qo'lqopda ishlamaydi — karta/PIN zaxira usuli ko'zda tutilsin" (fingerprint fails with gloves → card/PIN fallback must exist). Confirms card and PIN as stored credentials, and an auth-policy record listing allowed factor combinations.

"qulf yuritmasi (relelar) va qulf quvvat chiqishi shkafning himoyalangan hajmi ichida qoladi — modul faqat autentifikatsiyalangan (shifrlangan) signal yuboradi". Data: pairing/key material between terminal and per-cabinet controller; admin panel shows pairing status per cabinet.

Weapon statistics: "Turi, modeli, seriya raqami va RFID" (type, model, serial number, RFID tag). Binding: AK-74 and PM each "Seriya raqami va RFID identifikatori bilan". Weapon table: type (avtomat/to'pponcha), model, serial_no (unique), rfid_epc (unique), assigned officer/cabinet, slot, state.

AK-74 (943 mm; "AK-74M yig'ilgan 705 mm ham sig'adi") and Makarov PM (161×127×30). Exact AK/PM models are listed by 01 as data to obtain from the customer before the TZ ("AK/PM modellari"). Model catalogue table with default rows AK-74, AK-74M, PM.

AK stored "magazinsiz, bo'sh, saqlagichda" (no magazine, unloaded, on safe); PM stored in its box with 2 magazines. Slot rule attributes: expected_condition (unloaded, magazine detached), so return checks can flag violations.

"AK-74 uchun qo'ndoq ostidagi bosim datchigi, stvol qisqichidagi holat datchigi va RFID birgalikda ishlaydi. Kritik holat kamida ikki turdagi signal bilan tasdiqlanadi." Presence record per slot: rfid_seen, butt_pressure, clamp_state, derived presence with confidence (≥2 signals).
findings.source: 01 §4.3 'Mexanik/holat datchigi'; §4.5 'qurol mavjudligi uchun mustaqil holat datchigi'

findings.detail: "Ko'rik yoki ta'mirdan o'tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi" (a weapon that has not passed inspection or repair is blocked from re-issue); Armory System reference: "qurol holati, ko'rik, ta'mir va majburiy ish jarayonlari". Weapon condition state: serviceable / inspection_due / in_inspection / in_repair; inspection log (date, inspector, result, next due).
findings.source: 01 §4.4 'Xalqaro ish jarayoni' last line; §4.1 row 'Armory System'

findings.detail: Inventory statistics record each item as "Mavjud, yo'q, nosoz yoki xizmatda" (present, missing, faulty, in service/issued). This is the canonical item availability enum for weapons, magazines, ammo and equipment.
Central function is "chain of custody": "kim, qachon, nimani oldi va qachon qaytardi". Custody entity: item FK, officer FK, taken_at, returned_at, cabinet FK, method, verified_by_sensor flag.

Magazines are bound "Inventar raqami va miqdori bilan" (inventory number and quantity); each magazine also gets an RFID identifier ("Har bir qurol, magazin va muhim jihoz RFID identifikatori orqali"). Magazine table: inventory_no, rfid_epc, type (AK 5,45×39 30-round / PM), capacity, slot index, state.

Concept kit: "4 ta AK magazini qulflanadigan uyada (30 mm qadam)" each "Magazin 5,45×39 (30 ta o'q) — bo'sh, alohida saqlanadi", plus "Makarov PM ... + 2 magazin" in the PM box. Default slot template: 4 AK magazine positions + 2 PM magazine positions.

"Magazin va o'q-dori bo'limlaridagi vazn datchigi joy bandligini va umumiy vazn o'zgarishini aniqlaydi. U o'q sonini yuridik dalil sifatida aniq tasdiqlamaydi" — weight is an indicator, not legal proof of round count. Store weight readings (grams, timestamp, expected) as auxiliary signal; the registered count remains the accounting value.

Ammo bound "Turi, kalibri, partiyasi va soni bilan" (type, calibre, batch/lot, count); statistics: "Kalibr, partiya va miqdor". Ammo lot table: type, calibre, batch_no, quantity, cabinet/slot FK, issue/return deltas.

"Yopiq po'lat o'q-dori qutisi 240 × 200 × 130 (bel balandligida) qulflanadigan 3 × 30 kamar ostida + 2 o'q pachkasi" with packs labelled "O'q pachkasi 5,45×39". Only 5,45×39 (AK) ammo appears explicitly; PM (9×18) ammo is implied by the pistol but not itemised.

"Dubulg'a/bronjilet — Inventar raqami bilan"; "Body-kamera — Qurilma seriya raqami bilan". Equipment table: category, inventory_no (helmet, armour, etc.) or device serial (body camera), optional rfid_epc, assigned cabinet/slot, state.

Kit items named across sources: dubulg'a (6B47), bronjilet, gaz niqobi (sumkasi), kishan (BRS 230×90×28), taktik sumka (450×300×195), kamar + PM koburasi + kishan cho'ntagi, kichik jihozlar qutisi (fonar, pichoq, tibbiy paket), body-kamera (01 only; no slot in 3D). Equipment category enum should include all of these.
findings.source: 01 §1.2, §2.3, §4.6 'Qurol, himoya vositasi, body-kamera va xizmat jihozlari'; 03 <aside> 'Jihozlar (1 askar)'; 03 JS addCab roles; 02 §5.3

findings.detail: "Har bir qurol, magazin va muhim jihoz RFID identifikatori orqali seriya yoki inventar raqamiga bog'lanadi" — weapons, magazines and 'important equipment' get RFID mapped to serial/inventory number, enabling automatic issue/return and fast inventory. Item table needs nullable rfid_epc and a flag whether RFID tracking is expected for that slot.

findings.topic: Kit composition to be confirmed by customer
findings.detail: Before the TZ the customer specifies "AK/PM modellari, magazinlar, o'q-dori, body-kamera va himoya jihozlarining aniq tarkibi". The kit template must be data-driven (editable catalogue), not hard-coded.

"RFID xizmat kartasi" is the primary identification factor; the concept integrates "Mavjud xizmat kartasi va ichki bazalar bilan" (existing service card and internal databases) rather than a foreign ID system. Card table: card_uid, officer FK, issued_at, status (active/blocked/lost), source (existing IIV card vs issued).
findings.source: 01 §4.2 list; §4.6 row 'Xorijiy identifikatsiya tizimi'; §2.3 row 'Kirish huquqi'

findings.detail: "shaxsiy PIN-kod" for officers; emergency opening uses "vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN" — a distinct special PIN for authorised persons. Store hashed personal PIN and separate hashed emergency PIN with role scope.
findings.source: 01 §4.2 list and box 'TAVSIYA ETILADIGAN AUTENTIFIKATSIYA'; §2.6 'Favqulodda kirish'

findings.detail: Factors: "barmoq izi" and "Face ID"; "Face ID biometrik shabloni himoyalangan shaklda saqlanadi" (stored in protected form); TZ will have a section on "axborot xavfsizligi va biometrik ma'lumotlarni himoya qilish". Biometric table: officer FK, modality (face/finger), encrypted template blob, enrolled_at, enrolled_by, device, version; never exported to dashboard.

"Asosiy: xizmat kartasi + barmoq izi yoki PIN. Qo'shimcha: Face ID. Favqulodda: vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit. Faqat Face IDga tayanish ... tavsiya etilmaydi." Policy record: primary factor combos, optional Face ID, emergency combo; configurable per armory.
Step 1 identify: "xizmat kartasi yoki Face ID"; step 2 confirm: "Barmoq izi yoki PIN". Access session record stores identify_method and confirm_method separately.
"Kirish usuli" recorded as "Karta, PIN, biometrika yoki favqulodda ochish". Event.method enum: CARD, PIN, BIOMETRIC (face/finger sub-type), EMERGENCY, plus MECHANICAL_KEY (01 §1.4).

"Oddiy xodim" — uses only own cabinet and permitted items; "Qurolxona mas'uli" — receives/issues weapons, registers inventory, assigns and blocks cabinets; "Navbatchi yoki komandir" — confirms duty permission, manages temporary authority and emergency opening; "Administrator" — manages users, system and electronics settings, "qurol olish vakolati avtomatik berilmaydi"; "Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat" — views journal, statistics, delays, emergency openings, inventory differences (read-only).

findings.topic: System role vs weapon authorization are separate
findings.detail: Administrator role explicitly does not confer weapon-taking authority. Model system_role (panel access) separately from weapon_permission (cabinet/item grants); a user may have either without the other.

"Hudud/respublika: Vakolat doirasida jamlangan monitoring va hisobot" — monitoring and reports aggregated within the viewer's authority scope. Role assignment carries a scope (unit, armory, region, republic).

Infographic compares "Сотрудник" (control: биометрия и видео; rights: доступ только к своей ячейке), "Оператор" (журнал всех действий; мониторинг и подтверждение), "Администратор" (аудит системных правок; техническая настройка). Maps onto 01: Сотрудник=Oddiy xodim, Оператор≈Qurolxona mas'uli + Navbatchi, Администратор=Administrator; 01's Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat has no infographic equivalent. Also implies an audit of system configuration changes (admin actions log).

"Favqulodda ommaviy ochish faqat vakolatli navbatchi, qurolxona mas'uli yoki komandir tomonidan"; method "vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN, zarur holatda ikki mas'ul shaxs tasdig'i"; "Har bir favqulodda ochilish o'chirib bo'lmaydigan alohida jurnalga yoziladi". Emergency event: initiator, second approver, scope (all cabinets in armory / subset), reason, timestamp, immutable separate journal table.

Infographic defines operating modes "Сбор" (rapid assembly/arming — 'значительно сокращает время вооружения личного состава') and "Тревога" (alarm). These correspond to 01's favqulodda ommaviy ochish; model an armory-level mode {normal, yig'ilish/sbor, trevoga} with start/end events and initiator.

findings.topic: Emergency participants to be defined by customer
findings.detail: Customer must answer "Kim ochadi, kim tasdiqlaydi, favqulodda kirishda nechta mas'ul shaxs qatnashadi" — the number of approvers for emergency opening is a configurable policy value, not a constant.
"To'liq audit: Har bir ochish, olish, qaytarish, rad etish va favqulodda operatsiya qayd etiladi". Event.type enum ⊇ {OPEN, TAKE, RETURN, DENY, EMERGENCY, LOCK, MECH_KEY, ...}.

"Sana, vaqt, xodim va qurol seriya raqami jurnalga yoziladi"; issue/return stats: "Sana, vaqt va davomiylik" (date, time, duration). Event fields: timestamp, officer FK, item FK/serial, cabinet FK, method, duration (derived from paired take/return).
"Rad etilgan kirish: Kim, qachon, sababi va urinishlar soni" — denial events store who (or unknown card/face), when, reason, and attempt count.

"Kechikish: Belgilangan vaqtda qaytarilmagan jihoz"; "Kech qaytarilganda mas'ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi"; dashboard: "vaqtida qaytarilmagan qurollar". Custody record needs due_at; alert record: type LATE_RETURN, recipient (responsible person), sent_at, acknowledged.

"Qaytarishda aynan biriktirilgan jihozlar joyiga qo'yilgani tekshiriladi"; "Qaytarishda aynan tegishli qurol tekshiriladi". Return event compares detected RFID/sensors with the assignment; mismatch → event RETURN_MISMATCH + alarm.

"o'chirib bo'lmaydigan audit jurnali" (non-deletable audit log); infographic: "все действия пишутся в неизменяемый журнал". Journal tables are append-only; no delete/update API; consider hash chaining.
findings.source: 01 §4.5 bullet 7; §2.6; 06 block 'Принцип Fail-secure и цифровой аудит'

findings.detail: "Offline ishlash: Markaziy tarmoq uzilganda mahalliy ruxsatlar va jurnal ishlashda davom etadi"; "internet bo'lmasa lokal ishlash va keyin sinxronlash"; armory controller holds "hodisalar keshi". Event needs local_seq/device id, created_at (device), synced_at (server); permissions replicated to armory controller with version.

5 000 cabinets × 4 events/day = 20 000 events/day ≈ 7 300 000 events/year; text journal is small, video and face images dominate storage. Journal table must be partitioned/indexed for tens of millions of rows; media stored separately by reference.

Infographic: "Каждое открытие и наличие оружия фиксируется датчиками и синхронизируется с видеозаписью"; 01 retention distinguishes "oddiy kirish videosi" and "buzishga urinish videosi"; customer integration includes "videokuzatuv tizimlari". Event may reference a video clip (uri, camera id, start/end, class normal/tamper).

With a metal door, 01 recommends "ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko'rsatish" (show interior state on camera/screen). Cabinet may have an interior camera stream/snapshot reference for the admin panel instead of a glass window.

Administrator control = "Аудит системных правок" (audit of system edits); 01 Tekshiruvchi views journals. Configuration/user changes (role grants, permission edits, cabinet assignment/blocking) must be logged with actor, before/after.

Dashboard shows "inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar"; RFID enables "tez inventarizatsiya"; qurolxona mas'uli "inventarni ro'yxatdan o'tkazadi". Entities: inventory_session (armory, started_by, timestamp, expected vs found), inventory_discrepancy (item, expected state, found state).

"Signal: Urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi va quvvat uzilishi" (impact, break-in/tamper, door left open, power loss). Plus derived alarms: late return (01 §3.4), repeated denied attempts (01 §3.4), hatch tamper on the module (03), return mismatch. Alarm entity: type, severity, cabinet/terminal FK, raised_at, acknowledged_by/at, resolved_at.

Detection chain: sensor → "elektronika moduli → qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE)" and the guarded weapons room. Notification target entity (guard post, responsible person) with channel (panel, LTE/SMS).

findings.topic: Cabinet does not replace armory security
findings.detail: "Metall shkaf Smart tizim bo'lsa ham, qurolxona, jismoniy qo'riqlash va signalizatsiya talablarini almashtirmaydi". Armory record should reference the external guard/fire alarm system (qo'riqlash-yong'in signalizatsiyasi) for integration/escalation.

Infographic: "При сбое питания ячейки остаются заблокированными" (on power failure cells stay locked); 01 TZ section "favqulodda holatlar va fail-safe/fail-secure siyosati"; mechanical key is the fallback. Lock policy attribute fail_mode = secure; mechanical override event.
findings.source: 06 block 'Принцип Fail-secure и цифровой аудит'; 01 §5 TZ sections; §4.2 box

findings.detail: Nine KPIs: "jami va mavjud qurollar"; "ayni paytda xodimlarga berilgan qurollar"; "vaqtida qaytarilmagan qurollar"; "nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar"; "sutkalik olish-qaytarishlar"; "rad etilgan kirish urinishlari"; "favqulodda ochilishlar"; "inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar"; "hudud va bo'linmalar bo'yicha holat". Each is a query over weapon state, custody, cabinet state, events, alarms, inventory sessions with region/unit grouping.

Infographic: "Мониторинг готовности 24/7 — Командование в реальном времени видит точную статистику: кто из сотрудников вооружен, а кто — нет". Requires per-officer armed/unarmed derived state from open custody records.

"hodisalar jurnali uzoq muddat saqlanadi; Face ID biometrik shabloni himoyalangan shaklda saqlanadi; oddiy kirish videosi cheklangan muddat saqlanadi; buzishga urinish videosi alohida arxivlanadi; ma'lumotlar O'zbekiston hududidagi mahalliy serverda saqlanadi." Retention-policy table: data_class ∈ {journal, biometric, video_normal, video_tamper}, retention_days (journal = long/indefinite, tamper video = archive), storage_location = local UZ server.

Customer supplies "Jurnal, biometrika va videoni saqlash muddati hamda arxiv talabi" — exact retention periods are a configurable parameter to be filled at TZ stage (already scheduled in 01, not an open question for the user).

"mavjud HR, navbatchilik va kirish nazorati tizimlari bilan API integratsiyasi"; customer lists "Mavjud xodimlar bazasi, xizmat kartasi, navbatchilik va videokuzatuv tizimlari". Officer, card, shift and video records need external_id/source fields for HR, duty-roster, access-control and CCTV systems.

Access check uses "xizmat navbati"; sizing needs "har bir bo'linmadagi qurolli smena xodimlari soni"; customer supplies "smena va foydalanuvchilar soni". Shift entity: unit, start/end, roster of officers, armed flag; feeds authorization windows and expected return time.

Scenarios from 22 cabinets (one small IIB) to 27 500 (national); formula "Shkaflar soni = qurol biriktirilgan xodimlar soni + 5–10% zaxira". IDs and indices must scale to ~30k cabinets, ~30k officers, ~100k items.

"Prototip — Korxona laboratoriyasi — 1–2"; "Sinov — Bitta qurolxona — 10–20"; "Pilot — Bitta IIB/maxsus bo'linma — 30–50"; "Hududiy pilot — Bitta viloyat — 300–500"; "Respublika — 5 000+". Seed data for the prototype: 1 armory, 1–2 cabinets, ≤5 users; schema must already carry region/unit levels for later stages.

Concept BOM parts 1–11 with roles (tub, tsokol, yon devor, orqa devor, ichki qoplamalar, o'rta to'siq→o'ng qoplama, tokchalar 9-4/9-5/9-6, ustki qopqoq, eshik) and removed instances 11-2, 3-6, 5-6, 9-7, 9-8. Only relevant to the admin panel as a static 'model revision' descriptor (hardware_revision, drawing ref), not as live data.
findings.source: 03 META.bom / META.removed; 05 ROLES dict and REMOVE set

findings.detail: "Polga kamida 2 ta M12 anker; devorga M8–M10 qo'shimcha mahkamlash" — installation is a required condition; cabinet record can carry installed_at, installed_by, anchoring_checked flag (commissioning checklist).
Standards EN 14450 S1/S2, EN 1143-1, EN 1300, IEC 60529 (IP of electronics) listed as project references; certification class is a per-model attribute to store (certificate no., class) once tested.

"xizmat holati" appears both as an officer statistic and as a component of access right; blocking an officer (status change) must immediately revoke cabinet access without deleting the assignment history.
5–10% reserve cabinets exist without an officer; cabinet.officer_id must be nullable and assignment history kept (valid_from/valid_to) for audit when cabinets are re-bound.

contradictions.issue: Door construction: glass viewing windows (44.4 P4A laminate, glass-break sensor + 3-axis accelerometer) vs metal door.
contradictions.sources: 02 §5.5, §6; 03 <aside> 'Oynali eshik', META.windows/glass; 06 image (glass-fronted cell) — versus 01 §1.5 box 'OYNALI ESHIK BO'YICHA XAVF' and user decision 2026-09-09
contradictions.resolution: Metal door per 01 and the user. Data-model impact: drop 'glass_break' sensor type; keep impact (urilish) and tamper (buzish) sensors from 01 §1.4; add optional interior camera/snapshot reference per cabinet (01 §1.5: 'ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko'rsatish').

contradictions.issue: Electronics topology: one full-height Face ID/fingerprint module with SBC, UPS and LTE router per cabinet vs shared terminal per 10–20 cabinets plus cheap local controller per cabinet and one armory controller/gateway.
contradictions.sources: 02 §5.4; 03 <aside> 'Modul korpusi', 'Ichki joy', 'Aloqa va EMC' — versus 01 §3.3 and §4.7
contradictions.resolution: 01 governs: Terminal (1) — Cabinet (10–20) — Controller (1 per cabinet, ESP32) — ArmoryController (1 per qurolxona, Raspberry Pi). Module telemetry fields from 02/03 (battery, UPS, LTE, hatch tamper, temperature) attach to the Terminal/ArmoryController entities rather than to every cabinet.

contradictions.issue: Authentication sequence: Face → fingerprint → unlock (no card) vs card + fingerprint/PIN primary, Face ID only additional.
contradictions.sources: 03 JS auth state machine and <aside> note 'yuzni tanish → barmoq izi → qulf ochiladi'; 02 §5.4 'Ssenariy' — versus 01 §4.2 box 'TAVSIYA ETILADIGAN AUTENTIFIKATSIYA' and §2.5 steps 1–2
contradictions.resolution: 01 governs: service card is a mandatory credential entity; Face ID is an optional identify factor; fingerprint or PIN confirms. The 03 state machine is extended with 'card' and 'pin' steps; 'idle/face/finger/ok/open/lock' remain valid state names.

contradictions.issue: Cabinet dimensions 400 × 646 × 2056 (from SOLIDWORKS) vs 2000 × 400 × 600 (adopted).
contradictions.resolution: 01 governs (2000×400×600; 2000×600×600 with module). Only affects the cabinet model descriptor; slot heights in the concept (1293/1553/1812) are indicative and 01 §1.2 zone ranges are authoritative for the slot template.

contradictions.issue: Role set: three roles (Сотрудник / Оператор / Администратор) vs five roles.
contradictions.sources: 06 infographic 'Сравнение возможностей по ролям' — versus 01 §2.4 'Tizim rollari'
contradictions.resolution: Use 01's five roles (Oddiy xodim, Qurolxona mas'uli, Navbatchi yoki komandir, Administrator, Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat). Map 06 'Оператор' to Qurolxona mas'uli + Navbatchi; keep 06's 'audit of system edits' as an admin-action log requirement.

contradictions.issue: Storage unit: multi-cell shared armory cabinet ('персональная ячейка') vs one whole cabinet per officer.
contradictions.sources: 06 image (many small cells in one cabinet) — versus 01 concept 'Bir xodim — bir shkaf', §2.3, §4.6
contradictions.resolution: 01 governs: the unit of assignment is a whole cabinet; 'yacheyka/cell' in 06 = cabinet. Sub-compartments (PM box, ammo box, magazine slot) are slots/locks inside one cabinet, not separately assignable cells.

contradictions.issue: Officer identifier shown at terminal as 'Xodim #01' vs tabel raqami as the key.
contradictions.resolution: tabel raqami is the natural key; the terminal display label is a presentation field (short id / name), not a separate identifier.

contradictions.issue: Emergency method wording: 'vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN, zarur holatda ikki mas'ul shaxs tasdig'i' vs 'vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit'.
contradictions.resolution: Not a true conflict: emergency = card + special PIN (+ optional second approver per policy); mechanical key is the last-resort fallback and is logged as its own event type (01 §1.4). Model both approver_2 and mech_key_used fields on the emergency event.

contradictions.issue: Shelf-zone contents: 01 puts 'o'q-dori qutisi yoki bronjilet' in the 1150–1450 zone and PM/magazines/kishan in 1450–1700; 02/03 put ammo box on shelf 1293, PM box + magazines on 1553, kamar/kishan on a hook plate at z 880–1270 and bronjilet on a rod at z 1230.
contradictions.resolution: Compatible within tolerance (1293 shelf top ≈ o'rta zone; 1553 ≈ yuqori-o'rta). Use 01 zones as the slot template's zone field; 02/03 placements are default slot instances. Since 01 says shelves are adjustable, slot heights are per-cabinet configuration data.

gaps: Enum values for officer "xizmat holati" are not defined in any source. Safe default (no need to ask): faol / ta'tilda / vaqtincha chetlashtirilgan / ishdan bo'shagan; only 'faol' permits access.

Identifier formats (tabel raqami, shkaf raqami, weapon seriya raqami, inventar raqami, RFID EPC, card UID) are not specified anywhere. Safe default: free-text unique strings with per-organisation uniqueness; RFID EPC hex; do not invent check-digit rules.

Expected-return deadline rule ("belgilangan vaqt") is not defined: end of shift? fixed hours? Safe default: due_at = end of the officer's current shift + configurable grace (e.g. 60 min), overridable per issue by Navbatchi.

Denial reason list ("sababi") is not enumerated. Safe default enum: no_permit, outside_shift, status_inactive, unknown_card, biometric_mismatch, wrong_pin, cabinet_blocked, weapon_not_inspected, lockout, offline_no_cached_permit.
Lockout threshold after repeated failed attempts ("urinishlar soni") is not given. Safe default: 5 attempts / 15 min lockout, configurable.

PM ammunition (9×18) is never itemised — only 5,45×39 packs appear in 02/03. Safe default: add 9×18 as a second ammo type in the catalogue; exact composition is already scheduled to be confirmed with the customer in 01 §5.1 (do not ask the user).

Body camera has no physical slot in the 3D concept although 01 §2.3 binds it by device serial. Safe default: register as equipment in 'kichik jihozlar qutisi' slot or as 'carried' item without a sensor.

Which equipment carries RFID vs inventory-number only (01 §4.3 says 'muhim jihoz'). Safe default: RFID on weapons, magazines, body camera; helmet/bronjilet/gas mask/handcuffs by inventory number with optional RFID.

Depth of the organisational hierarchy (viloyat → tuman/shahar IIB → bo'linma → qurolxona) is implied but not fixed. Safe default: 4-level closure table (region, organisation, unit, armory) matching 01 §4.7 levels.

Retention durations for journal, biometrics and video are explicitly deferred to the customer (01 §5.1 'Saqlash'). Prototype default: journal indefinite; normal access video 30 days; tamper video indefinite archive; biometric templates until de-assignment + 90 days. Do not ask the user.
Number of approvers for emergency opening is deferred to the customer (01 §5.1 'Vakolat'). Prototype default: 2 (01 §2.6 recommendation), configurable per armory. Do not ask the user.

Whether the existing IIV service card technology (Mifare/EM/other) will be reused is an integration question deferred to the customer (01 §5.1 'Integratsiya'). Prototype default: store card UID as opaque string; reader type configurable.
Semantics of cabinet "manzil" are not defined (armory address vs position in room). Safe default: armory FK + wall/row + index; display both.
Secondary UI language: 06 is in Russian while all deliverables are Uzbek. Safe default: Uzbek (Latin) primary with i18n keys, Russian optional later.

findings.detail: 01 §2.4 defines exactly five roles: "Oddiy xodim" (uses only own bound cabinet and permitted equipment); "Qurolxona mas'uli" (receives/issues weapons, registers inventory, binds and blocks cabinets — "shkafni biriktiradi va bloklaydi"); "Navbatchi yoki komandir" (confirms duty permission "xizmat ruxsatini tasdiqlaydi", manages temporary authority "vaqtinchalik vakolat" and emergency opening "favqulodda ochish"); "Administrator" (manages users, system and electronics settings; weapon-taking authority is NOT granted automatically — "qurol olish vakolati avtomatik berilmaydi"); "Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat" (read-only: journal, statistics, delays, emergency openings, inventory differences). Admin panel: 5 roles, separation of duties — Administrator role must not confer issue rights; every role action is audited.

06 compares Сотрудник (control: biometrics + video; rights: access only to own cell), Оператор (control: journal of all actions; rights: monitoring and confirmation), Администратор (control: audit of system edits; rights: technical settings). Mapping: Сотрудник = Oddiy xodim; Оператор = Qurolxona mas'uli + Navbatchi (confirmation = 01 §2.4 'xizmat ruxsatini tasdiqlaydi'); Администратор = Administrator. Rule carried over: configuration changes made in the admin panel are themselves journaled ("аудит системных правок").

findings.topic: Eligibility preconditions for binding a cabinet to an officer
findings.detail: An officer gets a cabinet only if ALL five hold: service weapon officially assigned; authority to store and carry; special training passed; periodic professional fitness check passed; commander's order granting weapon-taking right. 'HUQUQIY TAMOYIL': the cabinet does not create authority, only verifies and records existing authority. Admin panel: officer profile stores these five attributes with dates/document references; cabinet binding is refused unless all are true; expiry of the periodic check → issue permission suspended automatically.

"Bir xodim — bir shkaf": every cabinet is bound to exactly one officially authorized officer profile. Also 'Individual hisob': weapon, magazine, ammo and equipment recorded by inventory/serial number. Admin panel: uniqueness constraint cabinet↔officer; rebinding is an audited operation performed by Qurolxona mas'uli.

findings.topic: Binding model: what is bound to a cabinet and by which identifier
findings.detail: Cabinet → one officer and one duty station; AK-74 and PM → serial number + RFID; magazines → inventory number + quantity; ammo → type, caliber, batch, count; helmet/body armor → inventory number; body camera → device serial; access right → service card + biometrics/PIN + service status ("xizmat holati"). Cabinet number, officer 'tabel raqami' and equipment IDs are linked in one electronic profile.

(1) Officer identified by service card or Face ID; (2) identity confirmed by fingerprint or PIN; (3) system checks duty shift ("xizmat navbati"), position ("lavozim") and current permission ("amaldagi ruxsat"); (4) if permitted, ONLY the relevant cabinet opens; (5) removal of weapon and equipment recorded via sensors; (6) date, time, officer and weapon serial written to the journal; (7) on return, it is verified that exactly the bound items are put in place; (8) door closes and cabinet auto-locks. Admin panel: each step is an event row (identify, verify, authorize, unlock, item-removed, item-returned, door-closed/locked) with cabinet, officer, method, timestamp.

findings.topic: International workflow additions to the flow
findings.detail: Identified item is written to the protected audit journal; late return sends a signal to the responsible person; on return exactly the proper weapon is checked; re-issue of a weapon that has not passed inspection or repair is blocked ("Ko'rik yoki ta'mirdan o'tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi").

findings.topic: Unlock ≠ door open: door is manual, no electric drive
findings.detail: The door has no electric drive and is opened by hand ("eshik qo'lda ochiladi, elektr yuritma yo'q"; "O'ng eshikka elektr yuritma qo'yilmasin — u qo'lda ochiladi"). Therefore two distinct events: 'lock released' (command) and 'door opened' (door sensor). Admin panel: show both; an unlock with no subsequent door-open within a timeout should re-lock (engineer default) and be logged as 'unlock unused'.
findings.source: 02 §5.4 Ssenariy; 03 aside note after spec list

findings.topic: Auto-lock is driven by the door-closed sensor
findings.detail: Locking is automatic when the door closes ("qulflash eshik yopilganda avtomatik (eshik sensori)"); the viewer's JS comment states the lock is driven by the door-closed sensor, not by a second press, because an open door can hide the reader. 01 §2.5 step 8 confirms 'Eshik yopilib, shkaf avtomatik qulflanadi'. Event: door_closed → lock_engaged (with confirmation from lock bolt sensor if present).
findings.source: 03 spec li 'O'quvchi'; 03 JS animateDoors() comment; 01 §2.5 step 8; 02 §5.4

findings.topic: Removal/return detection requires ≥2 sensor types for critical states
findings.detail: For the AK-74, a buttstock pressure sensor, a barrel-clamp state sensor and RFID work together; "Kritik holat kamida ikki turdagi signal bilan tasdiqlanadi" — a critical state (weapon taken/returned) is confirmed by at least two sensor types. Admin panel: item presence shown with sensor agreement; disagreement → 'sensor mismatch' warning on the cabinet card, not a confirmed issue/return.
findings.source: 01 §4.3 Mexanik/holat datchigi; 01 §4.5 'qurol mavjudligi uchun mustaqil holat datchigi'

findings.topic: Weight sensor is advisory, not legal round count
findings.detail: Weight sensors in magazine/ammo compartments detect occupancy and total weight change; they do NOT confirm round count as legal evidence, only give an additional inventory signal. Admin panel: show weight delta as advisory ('taxminiy'), never as a counted number of rounds.

findings.topic: Weapon and ammo status monitored independently
findings.detail: "Qurol va o'q-dori holati mustaqil nazorat qilinadi" — separate presence/state for weapon and ammunition. Admin panel: separate indicators per cabinet for rifle, pistol, magazines, ammo box (present/absent/unknown).

findings.topic: Return verification must match exact bound items
findings.detail: On return the system checks that exactly the bound items ("aynan biriktirilgan jihozlar") are put back; international workflow: "Qaytarishda aynan tegishli qurol tekshiriladi". A different RFID/serial than bound → mismatch. Admin panel: return event carries verified/mismatch flag; mismatch surfaces as inventory discrepancy and alert to Qurolxona mas'uli.

findings.topic: Rifle stored empty, no magazine, on safe — return rule
findings.detail: AK-74 is stored "magazinsiz, bo'sh, saqlagichda" (without magazine, empty, on safe); magazines (4 × 5.45×39, 30 rounds, stored empty and separately) go in a lockable magazine slot; ammo in a sealed steel can under a lockable strap. Admin panel: return checklist expects rifle present in clamp AND magazines present in slot AND ammo can present; rifle-with-magazine cannot be sensed but the rule should be shown to the officer on the terminal.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'AK-74 uyasi', 'Jihozlar (1 askar)', addCab magazine roles; 02 §5.2, §5.3

findings.detail: Viewer JS `auth.state` sequence: 'idle' → 'face' (1300 ms progress) → 'finger' (1400 ms progress) → 'ok' (700 ms, then door set to 100°) → 'open' → 'lock' (1500 ms, triggered when all doors return to 0°) → 'idle'. authenticate() is ignored unless state is 'idle' (no re-entry mid-sequence); pressing while 'open' requests door close, which cascades to 'lock'. Admin panel: cabinet live state should mirror these: LOCKED/IDLE, AUTH_IN_PROGRESS (identify/verify), AUTHORIZED (unlocked, door still closed), OPEN, LOCKING/LOCKED.

idle: "Yuzingizni kameraga qarating"; face: "Yuz tanilmoqda…" + "NN %"; finger: "Barmoq izini beshikka qo'ying"; ok: "Ruxsat · Xodim #01" / "Chapga qadam qo'ying, eshikni oching"; open: "Eshiklar ochiq" / "Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi"; lock: "Qulflandi". Header: 'SMART SHKAF' left, right shows 'OCHIQ' when state is open, otherwise 'QULF'. A progress bar is drawn in face and finger states. Note the display shows an officer ID ('Xodim #01'), not a name.
findings.source: 03 JS drawScreen() msg map; 03 spec li 'Displey' (3.5″, shows status, instructions, officer ID)

findings.detail: 60 × 3 mm status strip and the fingerprint LED ring (both set by setLeds): blue #2f9bff — waiting ("kutish") for idle and face; amber #ffb547 — fingerprint ("barmoq"); green #3ddc84 — permitted ("ruxsat") for ok and open; red #ff5252 — locked ("qulf"). No color is defined for 'denied' or 'alarm' (see gaps). Admin panel: use the same color language for cabinet state chips so the terminal and the dashboard agree.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'Holat LED'; 03 JS drawScreen() col map and setLeds()

findings.detail: Two interior 12 V LED strips switch on via Face ID or the door sensor ("Face ID / eshik datchigi orqali yonadi"). Event: interior_light on/off tied to auth OK and door state; not security-relevant but useful for cabinet health (LED failure).

Primary: service card + fingerprint or PIN. Additional: Face ID. Emergency: authorized card + special PIN + mechanical key. Relying on Face ID alone is not recommended (mask, helmet, lighting, camera failure). Identification methods in scope: RFID service card, personal PIN, fingerprint, Face ID, central permission system, two-officer confirmation for high-risk operations. Admin panel: per-officer enrolled factors; per-event 'Kirish usuli' = karta / PIN / biometrika / favqulodda (01 §3.4).
findings.source: 01 §4.2 Xodimni aniqlash + 'TAVSIYA ETILADIGAN AUTENTIFIKATSIYA' box; 01 §3.4 'Kirish usuli'

findings.detail: "Ikki bosqichli tasdiqlash": identity and authority verified via service card AND biometrics/PIN. Access right definition (01 §2.3) = service card + biometrics/PIN + service status. Rule: a single factor never unlocks.

findings.topic: Fingerprint fails with gloves → card/PIN fallback
findings.detail: Fingerprint sensor "qo'lqopda ishlamaydi — karta/PIN zaxira usuli ko'zda tutilsin" (does not work with gloves; card/PIN fallback must be provided). Admin panel: a fallback-method event should be distinguishable in the journal (method field) so frequent fallback use per officer/terminal is visible.

findings.topic: Authorization check inputs: duty shift, position, current permission, service status
findings.detail: Step 3 of the normal flow checks "xizmat navbati, lavozim va amaldagi ruxsat"; access right includes "xizmat holati" (01 §2.3); international reference includes "vaqt bo'yicha vakolat" (time-based authority, Traka). Admin panel: permission = f(officer active, shift window from duty roster, position, explicit issue permission, weapon status OK, cabinet not blocked). Each denied check reason is a coded deny reason.

Navbatchi/komandir 'confirms duty permission' and 'manages temporary authority' ("vaqtinchalik vakolat"). Admin panel: time-boxed permission grants (start/end, reason, granting officer), audited; expire automatically; show active temporary grants on the dashboard.

findings.topic: Two separate permissions inside one cabinet: rifle vs pistol/ammo
findings.detail: Barrel-clamp solenoid lock ("stvol qulfi", released via Face ID) and the PM pistol box electronic lock are "ikkita alohida ruxsat (avtomat / to'pponcha)" — two separate permissions; the ammo-can lock strap solenoid is tied to the PM-box permission ("+x oyoqda solenoid (PM qutisi ruxsati)"); AK magazines sit in a lockable slot ("qulflanadigan uyada"). Admin panel: per-officer permission set {door, rifle, pistol+ammo}; each sub-lock release is its own event; a shift may authorize pistol only.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'Beshik va qisqich', 'Oynali eshik' (ichki himoya paragraph), addCab roles 'Stvol qulfi', 'O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari'; 02 §5.4 'avtomat va PM qutisi uchun ikkita alohida ruxsat'

findings.topic: Lock driver stays inside the protected volume; module sends only authenticated signal
findings.detail: Lock relays and lock power output remain inside the cabinet's protected volume; the electronics module sends only an authenticated (encrypted) signal so opening the module cannot short the lock. Tamper sensors on module hatches, anti-pry hinge pins. Design constraint for the controller protocol: signed unlock commands; module_tamper event.

findings.topic: Interlock: rifle can be taken only with door ≥ 90°
findings.detail: Rifle removal (lift 15 mm, pull 30 mm, tilt ≥25°) is possible only when the door is open ≥ 90° (stop at 100°; below ~86° the door sweeps the rifle path) and the clamp lock is released. Viewer: toggleDrawer() refuses with tip "Avval eshikni 90° dan ortiq oching". This is a geometric rule; electronically the clamp solenoid should release only after door-open is sensed.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'Olish harakati', 'Eshik klirensi'; 03 JS toggleDrawer(); 02 §5.2 Olish; 02 §6 Ergonomika

findings.topic: Interlock: rifle returns to seat before door closes
findings.detail: "Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi": if a door close is requested while the rifle is pulled/tilted in the slot, the rifle retracts first (pendingDoor), tip "Avval avtomatlar joyiga qo'yiladi…"; the door slider is clamped to ≥ 90° while a rifle is out. Nuance: this concerns the rifle tilted-in-slot state, not an issued (fully removed) rifle — after full removal the door closes normally and that is the issue event. Electronically: clamp state sensor must read 'seated' or 'absent', never 'partially seated', before lock engages; otherwise warn.
findings.source: 03 JS requestDoors(), animateDrawers() interlock comment, door slider handler; 03 spec li 'Olish harakati'

findings.detail: "Rad etilgan kirish": who, when, reason and number of attempts ("Kim, qachon, sababi va urinishlar soni"). Deny reasons implied by the sources: outside duty shift / position mismatch / no current permission (01 §2.5 step 3); eligibility not met or expired (01 §2.2); service status inactive (01 §2.3); cabinet blocked by Qurolxona mas'uli (01 §2.4); weapon not inspected/repaired (01 §4.4); biometric/PIN mismatch; unknown card; attempt on another officer's cabinet (01 §2.5 step 4 'faqat tegishli shkaf'). Admin panel: deny events with coded reason, attempt counter per officer/terminal, dashboard tile 'rad etilgan kirish urinishlari'.

Qurolxona mas'uli can bind and block a cabinet ("shkafni biriktiradi va bloklaydi"); dashboard lists "nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar". Admin panel: cabinet states include 'bloklangan' (blocked, manual) and 'nosoz' (faulty, technical); blocked cabinet denies all normal access; emergency opening still possible per §2.6.

"Favqulodda ommaviy ochish" only by an authorized navbatchi, qurolxona mas'uli or komandir. Recommended method: authorized card + special PIN; when necessary, confirmation by two responsible persons (two-person rule). Every emergency opening is written to a separate non-erasable journal ("o'chirib bo'lmaydigan alohida jurnal"). Admin panel: emergency-open action gated by role, optional second-confirmer step, separate 'Favqulodda' journal that cannot be edited/deleted, dashboard counter 'favqulodda ochilishlar'.

findings.topic: Emergency authentication includes the mechanical key
findings.detail: Emergency: "vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit"; two-officer confirmation is listed for high-risk operations. The exact number of responsible persons in emergency access is an item to be agreed with the customer (01 §5.1 'Vakolat': "favqulodda kirishda nechta mas'ul shaxs qatnashadi"). Admin panel: configurable N-person confirmation (1 or 2), default 2 for mass opening.

06 names two operating modes: "Сбор" (assembly / mass issue) and "Тревога" (alarm); their stated purpose is optimizing the issue process to significantly cut the arming time of personnel. Mapping to 01: 'Тревога' = §2.6 emergency mass opening (role-gated, card + special PIN, two-person, separate journal); 'Сбор' = a pre-authorized fast-issue window in which all rostered officers' issue permissions are active regardless of shift schedule but each officer still authenticates (see gaps for the open question of bypass). Admin panel: mode switch per armory/unit with who/when/reason, mode banner on dashboard, all issues during the mode tagged with mode id.

06: command sees in real time exact statistics of which officers are armed and which are not ("кто из сотрудников вооружен, а кто — нет"). Combined with 01 §3.5 'ayni paytda xodimlarga berilgan qurollar'. Admin panel: personnel readiness board per unit (armed / not armed / partially: rifle only / pistol only) derived from live issue state.

"Kechikish": equipment not returned by the set time ("Belgilangan vaqtda qaytarilmagan jihoz"); on late return a signal is sent to the responsible person ("mas'ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi"); 'kech qaytarish bo'yicha ogohlantirish' is an adopted feature; dashboard lists 'vaqtida qaytarilmagan qurollar'; Tekshiruvchi sees 'kechikish'. Issue/return records store duration ("davomiylik"). Admin panel: expected-return deadline per issue, overdue list with elapsed time, notification to Navbatchi/Qurolxona mas'uli, escalation to komandir.

Construction requires door-state, impact ("urilish") and break-in-attempt ("buzishga urinish") sensors. Signal categories recorded: impact, break-in, door left open ("eshik ochiq qolishi"), power loss ("quvvat uzilishi"). Adopted features: 'eshik va buzishga urinish datchiklari'. Admin panel: alarm event types = impact, tamper/break-in, door_left_open, power_loss (+ power_restored), each with cabinet, timestamp, acknowledge-by, resolution note.

findings.topic: Detection chain: accelerometer/glass-break → module → guard post
findings.detail: Because the glazed door offers detection not delay, the design routes: glass-break sensor + 3-axis accelerometer → electronics module → guard post ("qorovul posti": signal, journal, LTE) inside a guarded, alarmed weapons room. With the user's metal-door decision the glass-break sensor is dropped but the 3-axis accelerometer (impact/tilt) and the guard-post forwarding remain valid. Admin panel: tamper alarm must also be pushed to the guard post / duty officer channel, not only shown on the dashboard.

findings.topic: Module service hatch tamper and service-door key locks
findings.detail: Module has a keyed front service door 155 × 1150 (battery tray, DIN frame) and an upper hatch 155 × 200 (LTE router), tamper sensors on hatches, anti-pry hinge pins, and physical wire-seal eyes on the cabinet door edge ("sim-plomba ko'zlari"; "plomba qulf emas"). Admin panel: module_hatch_opened event distinguished as 'maintenance' (scheduled/authorized technician) vs 'tamper' (unscheduled); optional seal number as cabinet attribute.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'Xizmat kirishi', 'Xavfsizlik' (module), addBox roles 'Xizmat eshigi qulfi', 'Yuqori lyuk qulfi'; 02 §5.4, §6

findings.topic: Every opening synchronized with video; break-in video archived separately
findings.detail: 06: each opening and weapon presence is fixed by sensors and synchronized with video recording. 01 §3.6: ordinary access video kept for a limited period; break-in-attempt video archived separately; face images/video sharply raise storage. Admin panel: event rows link to a video clip reference (not inline storage); tamper events carry a 'long-retention' flag.

findings.topic: Smart cabinet does not replace the armory's guard and alarm systems
findings.detail: Per O'RQ-550 the metal cabinet, even if Smart, does not replace the armory ("qurolxona"), physical guarding and the security/fire alarm ("qo'riqlash-yong'in signalizatsiyasi"). A responsible person for storage/issue/receipt/accounting must be appointed. Admin panel: armory entity with its designated responsible person; alarm forwarding to the existing armory alarm/guard post is an integration point, not a replacement.

'Eshik ochiq qolishi' is a signal category; door-state sensor required; the door has a 100° stop, rubber buffer and hydraulic closer (tends to close) and is opened manually. Terminal shows 'Eshiklar ochiq / Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi' while open. Admin panel: door_open duration timer per cabinet; warning then alarm after configurable thresholds (source gives no numbers — engineer default e.g. 60 s / 180 s); auto-lock cannot occur until the door is physically closed.

findings.topic: Power loss, backup power and fail-secure
findings.detail: 01 §1.4: backup power on mains failure; mechanical key use logged separately. 01 §4.7: UPS at armory level. 02 §5.4 / 03 'Ichki joy': module has 24 V/150 W PSU, DIN DC-UPS, 12.8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 (≈5 h). 06: fail-secure — on power failure cells stay locked and all actions go to an immutable journal. 01 §5 lists 'favqulodda holatlar va fail-safe/fail-secure siyosati' as a TZ chapter. Admin panel: power_loss / on_battery / battery_low / power_restored events with battery % telemetry; cabinet state 'on UPS'; on total power loss access = mechanical key only (logged on restore).
findings.source: 01 §1.4; 01 §4.7; 02 §5.4; 03 spec li 'Ichki joy'; 06 'Принцип Fail-secure и цифровой аудит'; 01 §5

findings.detail: When the central network is down, local permissions and the journal keep working ("Offline ishlash"); adopted feature: "internet bo'lmasa lokal ishlash va keyin sinxronlash"; localization difference: IIV local server and offline-first instead of cloud. Admin panel: per-armory and per-cabinet sync status (online / offline since T / pending events count), event flag 'recorded offline', permission cache age.

findings.topic: Five-level architecture and where events are cached
findings.detail: Per cabinet: electronic lock, RFID/ID, state sensors, ESP32/STM32-class controller. Per 10–20 cabinets: one Face ID terminal, screen, shared comms/control module. Per armory: local controller, UPS, event cache ("hodisalar keshi"), network gateway. Organization server: central DB, permissions, audit, dashboard. Region/republic: aggregated monitoring and reporting within authority scope. Admin panel entities: Region → Unit/Organization → Armory (local controller) → Terminal (10–20 cabinets) → Cabinet; sync and health per level.

findings.topic: Shared Face ID terminal opens only the officer's cabinet
findings.detail: 01 §3.3: a full-height electronics module per cabinet is too costly; one shared Face ID terminal, local controller and comms module per 10–20 cabinets, with lock, identifier, sensors and a cheap local controller per cabinet. Combined with §2.5 step 4 ('faqat tegishli shkaf ochiladi'): after authentication at a terminal, only the cabinet bound to that officer unlocks. Admin panel: terminal↔cabinet mapping; auth event at terminal T resolves to cabinet C.

Data are stored on a local server within the territory of Uzbekistan. Biometric (Face ID) templates stored in protected form. Admin panel: no external cloud; biometric templates never displayed/exported, only enrollment status.

findings.topic: Weapon inspection/repair block and inventory states
findings.detail: Re-issue of a weapon that has not passed inspection or repair is blocked ("Ko'rik yoki ta'mirdan o'tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi"). Inventory states: "mavjud, yo'q, nosoz yoki xizmatda" (present, absent, faulty, in service). Reference Armory System: 'qurol holati, ko'rik, ta'mir va majburiy ish jarayonlari' (mandatory workflows). Admin panel: weapon record has status {OK, ko'rik kutilmoqda, ta'mirda/nosoz, xizmatda}; status ≠ OK → the corresponding sub-lock is not released and deny reason 'qurol ko'rikdan o'tmagan'; status set/cleared by Qurolxona mas'uli with reason and date, audited.

findings.topic: Cabinet technical state and reserve cabinets
findings.detail: Cabinet statistics: number, address, technical state ("texnik holati"); dashboard 'nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar'. Sizing: cabinets = armed officers + 5–10 % reserve, so some cabinets are unassigned. Admin panel: cabinet lifecycle states — zaxira (unassigned), biriktirilgan (bound), bloklangan, nosoz, xizmatda (maintenance).

findings.topic: Mechanical key use logged as a separate event type
findings.detail: One external door with electronic lock and an emergency mechanical lock; "mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi" — mechanical key use is recorded separately. It is part of the emergency method (card + special PIN + mechanical key). Admin panel: event type 'mexanik kalit' distinct from electronic unlock; detection = door-open sensor without a preceding unlock command (or lock-cylinder switch if fitted); requires post-hoc reason entry by Qurolxona mas'uli; appears in the emergency journal and dashboard.

findings.topic: Inventory discrepancies and fast RFID inventory
findings.detail: Dashboard and Tekshiruvchi view include 'inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar'; RFID enables automation of issue/return and fast inventory ("tez inventarizatsiya"). Admin panel: inventory-audit run per armory comparing expected (bound) vs sensed items across all cabinets; discrepancy list with type (missing, extra/foreign RFID, sensor unknown).

"To'liq audit": every opening, taking, returning, denial and emergency operation is recorded. Adopted: "o'chirib bo'lmaydigan audit jurnali" (non-erasable audit journal). Core purpose per international practice: reliable 'chain of custody' — who, when, what was taken, when returned. 06: automation removes manual-entry errors and forgery of paper journals. Admin panel: append-only event store; no delete/edit endpoints; corrections only as new annotating events.
findings.source: 01 Loyiha konsepsiyasi table; 01 §4.5; 01 §4 intro; 06 'Устранение человеческого фактора'

findings.topic: Statistics data model (fields the system must record)
findings.detail: Officer: F.I.Sh., tabel raqami, bo'linma, xizmat holati. Cabinet: raqami, manzili, texnik holati. Weapon: turi, modeli, seriya raqami, RFID. Ammo: kalibr, partiya, miqdor. Issue/return: sana, vaqt, davomiylik. Access method: karta, PIN, biometrika, favqulodda ochish. Denied access: kim, qachon, sababi, urinishlar soni. Late: not returned by set time. Inventory: mavjud/yo'q/nosoz/xizmatda. Signal: urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi, quvvat uzilishi.

Average ~4 events per cabinet per day; 5 000 cabinets → 20 000 events/day, ≈7.3 M/year; text journal is small, video/face images are the storage driver. Event journal kept long-term. Admin panel/DB: SQLite fine for prototype (1–2 cabinets), PostgreSQL for pilot; video stored as references.

Event journal — long-term; Face ID biometric template — protected storage; ordinary access video — limited period; break-in video — separate archive. Exact retention periods for journal, biometrics and video are to be obtained from the customer before the TZ (01 §5.1 'Saqlash'). Admin panel: retention as configurable policy per data class, defaults to be confirmed.

Nine tiles: total and available weapons; weapons currently issued to officers; weapons not returned on time; faulty or blocked cabinets; daily issue/returns; denied access attempts; emergency openings; inventory discrepancies; status by region and unit. Regional level aggregates within the viewer's authority scope (01 §4.7).

API integration with existing HR, duty roster ("navbatchilik") and access-control systems; use the existing service card and internal databases instead of a foreign ID system; existing video surveillance to be integrated. Service status ("xizmat holati") is part of the access right, so an HR status change (dismissed, suspended, on leave) must revoke issue permission. Exact integration set to be clarified with the customer (01 §5.1 'Integratsiya').

findings.topic: Deployment scale for the admin panel MVP
findings.detail: Prototype: 1–2 cabinets in the company lab (mechanics + electronics test); trial: 10–20 cabinets in one armory (real process); pilot: 30–50 cabinets in one IIB/special unit (full hardware-software system); regional pilot 300–500 (local server, integration, statistics); republic 5 000+. Recommended practical start: 30–50 cabinets in one unit.

findings.topic: Terminal ergonomics facts relevant to UI copy
findings.detail: Reader is on the officer's right, beside the door, facing forward; door opens to the left away from the module so an open door never blocks the reader; Face ID camera at 1466 mm tilted 11° up; display 3.5″ at ≈1390 mm; fingerprint cradle 35° at ≈1290 mm. Hence the instruction 'Chapga qadam qo'ying, eshikni oching'. Admin panel: terminal configuration record (camera, display, fingerprint) for health status.
findings.source: 03 spec li 'Joylashuv', 'O'quvchi', 'Face ID moduli', 'Displey', 'Barmoq izi'; 02 §5.4 O'quvchi

findings.detail: Module is IP54, no forced cooling, thermostat heater 30–50 W if the storeroom drops below 5 °C; LTE external antenna. Admin panel: optional telemetry (temperature, heater on, link type/RSSI) on the cabinet/terminal health card.

findings.topic: Viewer safety comment: door–module clearance verified
findings.detail: JS comment records that the remaining door 11-3 keeps ≥3 mm to the new wall and ≥24 mm to the module across 0–100°, stop at 100° with hold; earlier variant verified ≥31 mm at 100° and first contact only at ~138°. Informational: no electronic interlock needed between door and module.
findings.source: 03 JS comments above NEW_WALL/MOD_BODY; 03 spec li 'Eshik klirensi'

contradictions.issue: Door material: 02 and 03 describe a glazed door (two 44.4 P4A laminate windows, glass-break sensor, 'tekshiruv shkafi' downgrade) while 01 §1.5 warns that a fully glazed outer door endangers certification under the 'seyf yoki metall shkaf' requirement and recommends a metal door with the interior shown via camera/screen.
contradictions.resolution: User decision + 01 as source of truth: metal door. Consequences for events: drop the glass-break event; keep impact/3-axis accelerometer and tamper events (01 §1.4); interior visibility becomes an internal camera/screen feature, so 'interior LED via Face ID/door sensor' remains but serves the camera, not windows.
contradictions.sources: 01 §1.5 box 'OYNALI ESHIK BO'YICHA XAVF' vs 02 §5.5, §6 and 03 spec li 'Oynali eshik'

contradictions.issue: Authentication order/factors: 03 scenario is Face ID → fingerprint → unlock with 'yuz — asosiy omil' (face as the primary factor); 01 §4.2 says primary = service card + fingerprint or PIN, Face ID only additional, and relying on Face ID alone is not recommended; 01 §2.5 identifies by card OR Face ID then confirms by fingerprint OR PIN; 06 says access after face OR fingerprint (single factor).
contradictions.resolution: Follow 01: identification (card or Face ID) + verification (fingerprint or PIN); 03's 'face'/'finger' states become generic IDENTIFY/VERIFY states whose method is recorded per event; single-factor access (06) is rejected.
contradictions.sources: 03 spec li 'Face ID moduli', JS tick(); 01 §4.2 box; 01 §2.5; 06 'Биометрический доступ'

contradictions.issue: Per-cabinet full-height electronics module with its own Face ID, controller, UPS and LTE router (02 §5.4, 03) vs 01 §3.3/§4.7 which reject a full module per cabinet as too costly and prescribe one shared Face ID terminal + local controller per 10–20 cabinets, a cheap controller per cabinet, and UPS/gateway at armory level.
contradictions.resolution: Follow 01: data model has Terminal (shared) and Cabinet (cheap controller) as separate entities; the 3D model's module is a visual for the terminal position. LTE becomes an armory-gateway concern, not per-cabinet.
contradictions.sources: 01 §3.3, §4.7 vs 02 §5.4 and 03 spec li 'Modul korpusi', 'Ichki joy', 'Xizmat kirishi'

contradictions.issue: 03 viewer animates the door swinging to 100° automatically after the 'ok' state, but both 02 §5.4 and the 03 note state the door is manual with no electric drive.
contradictions.resolution: The animation is a viewer convenience; in the real state machine 'ok' releases the lock and the transition to OPEN is driven by the door-open sensor. An unlock not followed by door-open should time out and re-lock (engineer default).
contradictions.sources: 03 JS tick() setDoors(100) vs 03 aside note and 02 §5.4

contradictions.issue: 03 interlock 'Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi' (door won't close while the rifle is out) could be read as 'rifle must be back before the door may close', which would contradict the issue flow of 01 §2.5 (rifle removed, door closed, cabinet locks).
contradictions.resolution: The 03 rule concerns the rifle tilted/pulled within the slot (geometric path conflict below ~86°), not an issued rifle; once fully removed the door closes and that closure is the normal issue event. Electronically: clamp sensor must not read 'partially seated' when the lock engages.
contradictions.sources: 03 JS requestDoors()/pendingDoor and spec li 'Olish harakati' vs 01 §2.5 steps 5–8

contradictions.issue: Role count: 06 shows three roles (Сотрудник, Оператор, Администратор); 01 §2.4 defines five.
contradictions.resolution: Use 01's five roles; 06's Оператор splits into Qurolxona mas'uli and Navbatchi/komandir, and Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat is added as read-only.

contradictions.issue: LED red is defined in 03 as 'qulf' (normal locked state); there is no distinct color for denied access or alarm, so red would be ambiguous between 'locked normally' and 'access denied/tamper'.
contradictions.resolution: Not resolved by sources; engineer default: keep 03's palette for normal states and add a distinct blinking-red pattern for deny/alarm, mirrored in the admin panel state chips.
contradictions.sources: 03 spec li 'Holat LED', JS drawScreen() col map; 01 §3.4 'Rad etilgan kirish'

gaps: Denied-access lockout policy: 01 §3.4 records attempt count but no threshold or lockout duration is given anywhere. Safe engineer default: 3 failed verifications → 5-minute lockout of that officer at that terminal + notification to Navbatchi; configurable.

Late-return deadline source: 01 §3.4 says 'belgilangan vaqtda' but does not say who sets the expected return time (shift end from the duty roster vs a per-issue time set by Navbatchi). Safe default: deadline = end of the officer's duty shift from the roster, overridable per issue by Navbatchi.
Door-left-open timeout values are not specified. Safe default: warning at 60 s, alarm at 180 s, configurable per armory.

Two-person rule scope: 01 §2.6 says 'zarur holatda' and 01 §5.1 explicitly lists 'how many responsible persons participate in emergency access' as a question for the customer. Implement as configurable N (1 or 2), default 2 for mass opening; do not ask the user now — the source itself defers it to IIV.

'Сбор' mode semantics (06 only): who may activate it, its scope (armory/unit), duration, and whether individual biometric verification is relaxed during it are not defined. Safe default: Сбор = pre-authorized issue window for all rostered officers with full individual authentication kept; Тревога = 01 §2.6 emergency mass opening.

Weapon inspection/repair workflow ownership: 01 §4.4 blocks re-issue but does not say who sets and clears 'ko'rik'/'ta'mir' status or on what schedule. Safe default: Qurolxona mas'uli sets/clears with reason; periodic inspection interval configurable.

Mechanical key detection and custody: no source says whether a lock-cylinder switch exists or who holds the key. Safe default: infer key use from door-open without unlock command, require a reason entry by Qurolxona mas'uli, keep key holder as an armory attribute.

Offline sync conflict handling (e.g., a permission revoked centrally while the armory is offline) is not described. Safe default: local permission cache with TTL, local monotonic event sequence per cabinet, idempotent merge by (cabinet_id, seq), revocations applied on reconnect and flagged if an issue happened in between.

Behavior on wrong item returned (different RFID than bound): sources only say it is 'checked'. Safe default: log 'noto'g'ri jihoz' event, alert Qurolxona mas'uli, mark inventory discrepancy; the manual door still closes and locks.
Retention periods for journal, biometrics and video are explicitly deferred to the customer (01 §5.1). Implement as configurable policy; no defaults given.
Temporary authority ('vaqtinchalik vakolat') duration limits and approval chain are not specified beyond the granting role.
Weight-sensor tolerance thresholds for magazine/ammo occupancy are not given; treat as advisory with configurable tolerance.
Video source for per-event linkage (terminal Face ID camera vs existing armory CCTV) is undefined; 01 §5.1 lists video surveillance integration as a customer question.
No terminal message/LED behavior is defined for denied access, tamper, or offline state (03 covers only the happy path).
Unlock-unused timeout (lock released but door never opened) is not defined; engineer default 10–15 s then re-lock and log.

findings.topic: Role: Oddiy xodim (ordinary officer) — no admin functions, at most a read-only 'Mening shkafim' card
findings.detail: 01 §2.4: 'Faqat o‘ziga biriktirilgan shkaf va ruxsat etilgan jihozlardan foydalanadi.' 06 role column 'Сотрудник': control = 'Биометрия и видео', rights = 'Доступ только к своей ячейке'. Screen implication: the officer interacts with the cabinet terminal, not the web panel; if a web view exists it is a personal read-only card. Data: tabel raqami, F.I.Sh., own shkaf raqami, list of assigned items with IDs, current in/out state per item, expected return time, own last N journal events.

findings.topic: Role: Qurolxona mas’uli (armory responsible) — issue/receive, inventory register, assign & block cabinets
findings.detail: 01 §2.4: 'Qurolni qabul qiladi/beradi, inventarni ro‘yxatdan o‘tkazadi, shkafni biriktiradi va bloklaydi.' Screens: Inventar ro‘yxati (create/edit weapon, magazine, ammo, equipment records), Shkafni biriktirish (officer↔cabinet↔equipment binding), Shkafni bloklash / blokdan chiqarish (reason, who, when), Qabul/berish tasdiqlash, Inventarizatsiya. 01 §1.3 makes this the legal 'mas’ul shaxs' for storage, issue, receipt and accounting → every qurolxona record needs a 'mas’ul shaxs' field.
findings.source: 01 §2.4 Tizim rollari; 01 §1.3 O‘zbekiston qonunchiligidagi bazaviy talab

findings.topic: Role: Navbatchi yoki komandir — duty approval, temporary authority, emergency opening
findings.detail: 01 §2.4: 'Xizmat ruxsatini tasdiqlaydi, vaqtinchalik vakolat va favqulodda ochishni boshqaradi.' Screens: Xizmat ruxsati tasdiqlash (queue of officers awaiting shift approval), Vaqtinchalik vakolat (officer, cabinet, valid from/to, reason, grantor), Favqulodda ochish (per cabinet or mass; card + special PIN; second-person confirmation per 01 §2.6). 06 'Оператор' column: 'Журнал всех действий' / 'Мониторинг и подтверждение' maps to this role plus qurolxona mas’uli.
findings.source: 01 §2.4 Tizim rollari; 01 §2.6 Favqulodda kirish; 06 role table 'Оператор'

findings.topic: Role: Administrator — users, system, electronics settings; explicitly NO weapon authority
findings.detail: 01 §2.4: 'Foydalanuvchi, tizim va elektronika sozlamalarini boshqaradi; qurol olish vakolati avtomatik berilmaydi.' Screens: Foydalanuvchilar va rollar, Tizim sozlamalari, Qurilma/elektronika sozlamalari (per cabinet controller, terminal, armory gateway). 06 'Администратор': 'Аудит системных правок' / 'Техническая настройка' → a settings-change audit log (who changed which setting when) is required.

findings.topic: Role: Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat — read-only reports module with 5 named report types
findings.detail: 01 §2.4: 'Jurnal, statistika, kechikish, favqulodda ochish va inventar farqlarini ko‘radi.' → Reports: (1) Hodisalar jurnali, (2) Statistika, (3) Kechikishlar, (4) Favqulodda ochilishlar, (5) Inventar farqlari. 01 §4.7 'Hudud/respublika: Vakolat doirasida jamlangan monitoring va hisobot' → this role is scoped to region/republic aggregates, no per-cabinet control actions.

06 presents a 3-column comparison ('Сравнение возможностей по ролям') with rows 'Контроль' and 'Права доступа'. Reuse the pattern as a permission matrix for 01's five roles (Oddiy xodim, Qurolxona mas’uli, Navbatchi/komandir, Administrator, Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat) × actions (view journal, issue/receive, assign, block, approve shift, temp authority, emergency open, settings, reports).

findings.topic: Scope rule: every list, KPI and report is filtered by the user's jurisdiction
findings.detail: 01 §4.7 'Vakolat doirasida jamlangan monitoring' and the 5-level architecture (shkaf → 10–20 shkaf terminal group → qurolxona → tashkilot serveri → hudud/respublika). Each web user carries a scope node (qurolxona / bo‘linma / viloyat / respublika); all queries are constrained to that subtree.

findings.topic: KPI tile: 'jami va mavjud qurollar' (total vs available weapons)
findings.detail: Count of registered weapons and how many are currently physically present in cabinets, split by type (AK-74 / PM per 01 §2.3). Data: qurol table (turi, modeli, seriya raqami, RFID — 01 §3.4) joined with presence sensor state (RFID + holat datchigi — 01 §4.3) and inventory status (mavjud/yo‘q/nosoz/xizmatda).

findings.topic: KPI tile: 'ayni paytda xodimlarga berilgan qurollar' (weapons currently issued)
findings.detail: Count + drill-down list of open issuances: xodim (F.I.Sh., tabel), qurol seriya, olish vaqti, elapsed davomiylik, expected return. Derived from 'olish' events without a matching 'qaytarish' (01 §3.4 Olish/qaytarish: sana, vaqt, davomiylik). This is the same dataset that feeds the 06 readiness widget.

findings.topic: KPI tile: 'vaqtida qaytarilmagan qurollar' (overdue / late returns)
findings.detail: List of items past their 'belgilangan vaqt' (01 §3.4 Kechikish: 'Belgilangan vaqtda qaytarilmagan jihoz'). Data: issuance record + expected return time + delay duration + xodim + notified responsible person. 01 §4.4 'Kech qaytarilganda mas’ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi' and §4.5 'kech qaytarish bo‘yicha ogohlantirish' → tile links to a notification/ack state.

findings.topic: KPI tile: 'nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar' (faulty or blocked cabinets)
