findings.detail: Count + list with reason. Data: shkaf texnik holati (01 §3.4 Shkaf: raqami, manzili, texnik holati), blocked flag set by qurolxona mas’uli (01 §2.4), fault source (lock, door sensor, RFID reader, weight sensor, power, comms), since-when, who blocked.

findings.topic: KPI tile + chart: 'sutkalik olish-qaytarishlar' (daily take/return volume)
findings.detail: Daily count of olish and qaytarish events, shown as number for today and a time-series (by day, optionally by hour/shift). Baseline expectation: ~4 events per cabinet per day (01 §3.6).

findings.topic: KPI tile: 'rad etilgan kirish urinishlari' (denied access attempts)
findings.detail: Count for period + list. Data per 01 §3.4 Rad etilgan kirish: kim, qachon, sababi, urinishlar soni. Reasons follow the checks in 01 §2.5 (identity not confirmed, no active shift/navbat, lavozim, no valid ruxsat) plus cabinet blocked (§2.4) and weapon not inspected/repaired (§4.4).
Count + link to the separate non-deletable emergency journal (01 §2.6). Data: cabinet(s), initiator (card), method (card + maxsus PIN, mechanical key), second confirmer, timestamp, reason.

Count of items whose registered state differs from detected state. Data: expected item list per cabinet (01 §2.3 binding) vs sensor-detected presence (RFID/weight/state sensor, 01 §4.3) and status enum mavjud/yo‘q/nosoz/xizmatda (01 §3.4 Inventar). Also the 'return mismatch' check of 01 §2.5 ('aynan biriktirilgan jihozlar joyiga qo‘yilgani tekshiriladi').

findings.topic: Widget: 'hudud va bo‘linmalar bo‘yicha holat' (status by region and unit)
findings.detail: Tree/table (optionally map) aggregating per node: cabinets total/online/blocked, weapons out, overdue, open alarms, denied attempts. Hierarchy from 01 §4.7 (qurolxona → tashkilot → hudud → respublika) and unit types from 01 §2.1 (tuman/shahar IIB, patrul-post xizmati, qo‘riqlash va tezkor bo‘linmalar, maxsus operatsion bo‘linmalar, navbatchilik qismlari, o‘quv markazlari).

findings.topic: Widget: readiness monitoring 24/7 — 'who is armed, who is not'
findings.detail: 06: 'Мониторинг готовности 24/7 — Командование в реальном времени видит точную статистику: кто из сотрудников вооружен, а кто — нет.' Mockup shows sidebar nav, a donut chart and a grid of officer figures colored green/red. Data: per officer in scope: armed (weapon out), not armed (weapon in cabinet), partial (e.g. PM out, AK in), plus totals. Derived from open issuances (01 §3.4) and presence sensors (01 §4.3).

findings.topic: KPI tiles from the three indicators IIV is asked for
findings.detail: 01 §3.6 callout: IIV must provide (1) qurol biriktirilgan xodimlar soni, (2) qurol saqlanadigan bo‘linmalar soni, (3) har bir bo‘linmadagi qurolli smena xodimlari soni. Once deployed the panel can compute these live: assigned-officer count, unit count with cabinets, armed-shift headcount per unit — expose them as tiles/report rows.
findings.source: 01 §3.6 callout 'ANIQ EHTIYOJ UCHUN KERAK BO‘LGAN MA’LUMOT'

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: F.I.Sh., tabel raqami, bo‘linma, xizmat holati. Add from 01 §2.2 the five eligibility conditions as flags with document/date: xizmat quroli rasmiy biriktirilgan; saqlash/olib yurish vakolati; maxsus tayyorgarlik; davriy professional yaroqlilik tekshiruvi; rahbar buyrug‘i. From 01 §2.5: lavozim, xizmat navbati. From 01 §2.3 'Kirish huquqi': xizmat kartasi + biometrika/PIN + xizmat holati (enrollment status only, never the template).

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: raqami, manzili, texnik holati. 01 §2.3: bound to 'bitta xodim va bitta xizmat joyiga'. 01 §4.7: belongs to a terminal group (10–20 cabinets share one Face ID terminal/screen/comms module) and a qurolxona (local controller, UPS, event cache, gateway). Add: blocked flag + reason, online/offline, last heartbeat, firmware, mechanical-key-used flag.

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: turi, modeli, seriya raqami, RFID. 01 §2.3: AK-74 and PM each 'Seriya raqami va RFID identifikatori bilan'. Add lifecycle from 01 §4.4/§4.1: inspection (ko‘rik) and repair (ta’mir) status, since 'Ko‘rik yoki ta’mirdan o‘tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi'.

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: kalibr, partiya, miqdor; 01 §2.3: 'Turi, kalibri, partiyasi va soni'. Magazinlar: 'Inventar raqami va miqdori'. Weight sensor gives occupancy and total-weight change but 'o‘q sonini yuridik dalil sifatida aniq tasdiqlamaydi' (01 §4.3) → UI shows weight delta as advisory, count as registered value.

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.topic: Entity Jihoz (equipment): helmet, body armour, body camera, others
findings.detail: 01 §2.3: Dubulg‘a/bronjilet — inventar raqami; Body-kamera — qurilma seriya raqami. Items placed in cabinet per 01 §1.2 zones also include taktik sumka, kishan, gaz niqobi, kichik jihozlar (no ID method given → default inventory number, optional RFID per 01 §4.3 'muhim jihoz').
findings.source: 01 §2.3 Biriktirish modeli; 01 §1.2 Ichki funksional zonalar; 01 §4.3 RFID

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: sana, vaqt, davomiylik. 01 §2.5 journal line: 'Sana, vaqt, xodim va qurol seriya raqami jurnalga yoziladi.' Add: shkaf raqami, kirish usuli, item list taken/returned, return-check result (match/mismatch), expected return time (for Kechikish).

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: karta, PIN, biometrika, favqulodda ochish. Split biometrika into barmoq izi and Face ID (01 §4.2). Add 'mexanik kalit' because 01 §1.4: 'mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi'. Useful stat: distribution of access methods (03 notes fingerprint fails with gloves → card/PIN fallback).

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: kim, qachon, sababi, urinishlar soni. Reason codes from the 01 §2.5 check chain (shaxs aniqlanmadi, tasdiqlanmadi, navbat yo‘q, lavozim, ruxsat yo‘q), cabinet blocked (01 §2.4), weapon blocked pending inspection (01 §4.4), outside temporary-authority window (01 §2.4).

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: mavjud, yo‘q, nosoz, xizmatda (present, missing, faulty, in service/issued). Use as status chip colours in inventory lists and as basis for 'inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar'.

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.detail: 01 §3.4: urilish (impact), buzish (tamper/break-in), eshik ochiq qolishi (door left open), quvvat uzilishi (power loss). Sensors behind them per 01 §1.4: 'Eshik holati, urilish va buzishga urinish datchiklari' + 'Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat'.

findings.section: C. Data model from 01 §3.4 statistics table
findings.topic: Single electronic profile linking cabinet, officer and equipment
findings.detail: 01 §2.3: 'Shkaf raqami, xodim tabel raqami va jihoz identifikatorlari yagona elektron profilga bog‘lanadi.' → Profile screen: header (officer + cabinet), tabs: biriktirilgan jihozlar, ruxsatlar (shift/temporary), jurnal, kechikishlar, rad etishlar.

findings.topic: Universal audit rule: five event classes always logged
findings.detail: 01 concept table 'To‘liq audit': 'Har bir ochish, olish, qaytarish, rad etish va favqulodda operatsiya qayd etiladi.' → Journal screen with event-type filter: ochish, olish, qaytarish, rad etish, favqulodda; plus system events (block, unblock, sync, alarm) as a separate class.

01 §2.6: 'Har bir favqulodda ochilish o‘chirib bo‘lmaydigan alohida jurnalga yoziladi.' → Dedicated tab/screen 'Favqulodda ochilishlar jurnali'; no edit/delete controls; fields: cabinet(s), initiator, method (vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN), second confirmer ('ikki mas’ul shaxs tasdig‘i'), timestamp, mechanical key flag, reason.

findings.topic: Immutable audit journal (no edit/delete in UI)
findings.detail: 01 §4.5: 'o‘chirib bo‘lmaydigan audit jurnali'; 01 §4.4: 'Hodisa himoyalangan audit jurnaliga yoziladi'; 06: 'все действия пишутся в неизменяемый журнал'. UI consequence: journal is append-only, export/print only; consider hash chaining and a 'verify integrity' control.

findings.topic: Mechanical key use is a distinct journal event
findings.detail: 01 §1.4: 'mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi.' → event type 'mexanik kalit bilan ochish' with prominent flag in journal and an alert to the responsible person.

01 §4 intro: central task is the weapon's full 'chain of custody' — 'kim, qachon, nimani oldi va qachon qaytardi'. → Weapon detail page with a custody timeline (issued to / returned by / inspected / repaired), reused by Real Time Networks & Traka references (01 §4.1).

findings.topic: Event ↔ video linkage in event detail
findings.detail: 06: 'Каждое открытие и наличие оружия фиксируется датчиками и синхронизируется с видеозаписью.' 01 §3.6 distinguishes 'oddiy kirish videosi' (limited retention) and 'buzishga urinish videosi' (archived). → Event detail shows a linked clip when available; tamper events link to the archive.
06 Administrator: 'Аудит системных правок'. 01 §2.4 Administrator manages user/system/electronics settings. → Screen 'Sozlamalar tarixi': who, when, setting key, old→new value, target device/unit.

From 01 §2.5 (sana, vaqt, xodim, qurol seriya raqami) + 01 §3.4 (kirish usuli, rad etish sababi, urinishlar soni, davomiylik) + 01 §2.3 (shkaf raqami) → columns: timestamp, hodisa turi, shkaf, xodim (tabel), jihoz/seriya, kirish usuli, natija, sabab, tasdiqlovchi, manba (online/offline-synced), video link.

findings.topic: Five inspector reports with common filters
findings.detail: 01 §2.4 report set: jurnal, statistika, kechikish, favqulodda ochish, inventar farqlari. Common filters: date range, hierarchy node (respublika→viloyat→bo‘linma→qurolxona→shkaf), xodim, qurol turi, hodisa turi, kirish usuli, smena.

findings.topic: Aggregated regional/republic monitoring and reporting level
findings.detail: 01 §4.7 top row: 'Hudud/respublika — Vakolat doirasida jamlangan monitoring va hisobot.' → Rollup reports per viloyat and republic with the same KPI set as §3.5, comparing units side by side.

Levels: respublika → hudud (viloyat) → tashkilot/bo‘linma → qurolxona → terminal group (10–20 cabinets) → shkaf → xodim. Unit types from 01 §2.1: tuman va shahar IIB, patrul-post xizmati, qo‘riqlash va tezkor bo‘linmalar, maxsus operatsion bo‘linmalar, navbatchilik qismlari, o‘quv markazlari; later Milliy gvardiya, bojxona, harbiy qismlar.

findings.topic: Scale scenarios the UI must handle
findings.detail: 01 §3.1 table (with 10% reserve): kichik IIB 22, o‘rtacha IIB 55, katta bo‘linma 110, viloyat piloti 550, respublika 1-bosqich 5 500, kengaytirilgan 11 000, milliy 27 500 cabinets. 01 §3.2 stages: prototip 1–2, sinov 10–20, pilot 30–50, hududiy pilot 300–500 ('Lokal server, integratsiya va statistika'), respublika 5 000+. Prototype UI can be simple; aggregate views must not render per-cabinet DOM for 27 500 nodes.

01 §3.6: 5 000 cabinets × 4 events/day ≈ 20 000 events/day, ≈7 300 000/year; 'Matnli jurnal hajmi katta emas; video va yuz tasvirlarini doimiy saqlash esa xotira talabini keskin oshiradi.' → Journal list uses server-side pagination and date-partitioned queries; video stored by reference with retention jobs.

findings.topic: Statistics module is an explicit goal of the regional pilot stage
findings.detail: 01 §3.2 'Hududiy pilot — Bitta viloyat — 300–500 — Lokal server, integratsiya va statistika.' and 'Pilot — 30–50 — To‘liq apparat-dasturiy tizim'. → Reports/statistics may be basic in prototype and mature by regional pilot.

06 'Устранение человеческого фактора: автоматизация исключает ошибки ручного ввода и подделку записей в бумажных журналах' (paper log crossed out). → Reports must be exportable/printable in a form acceptable as the official record (PDF/XLSX), with signature line for mas’ul shaxs (01 §1.3).
01 §3.6 callout mentions 'qurolli smena xodimlari soni'; 01 §2.5 checks 'xizmat navbati'. → Reports groupable by smena (shift) as well as by day.

findings.topic: Alarm center with four core alarm types
findings.detail: 01 §3.4 Signal: urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi, quvvat uzilishi. Widget: live alarm list with severity, cabinet, time, acknowledge/resolve, assigned handler, linked video (01 §3.6 tamper video). Sensors per 01 §1.4.

findings.topic: Late-return notification to the responsible person
findings.detail: 01 §4.4: 'Kech qaytarilganda mas’ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi.' 01 §4.5: 'kech qaytarish bo‘yicha ogohlantirish'. → Notification rule: overdue item → notify qurolxona mas’uli / navbatchi; UI shows notified/acknowledged state.

01 §4.4: 'Ko‘rik yoki ta’mirdan o‘tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi.' → Weapon record has inspection/repair flags; issue attempt produces a denied event with this reason; dashboard lists weapons blocked pending inspection.

06: 'При сбое питания ячейки остаются заблокированными, а все действия пишутся в неизменяемый журнал.' 01 §1.4: backup power on outage. → Cabinet status shows 'quvvat: UPS/batareya' and 'qulflangan (fail-secure)'; power-loss alarm raised.

findings.topic: Impact/tamper detection chain to guard post
findings.detail: 02 §6 / 03 aside: detection = 'shisha sinishi datchigi + 3 o‘qli akselerometr → elektronika moduli → qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE)'. With the metal door decided, keep the accelerometer/impact and tamper part (01 §1.4 urilish, buzishga urinish) and route alarms to the guard post/duty officer view; drop glass-break.
03 aside 'Xavfsizlik' (module): 'lyuklarda tamper-datchiklar'; 03 JS objects 'Xizmat eshigi qulfi' and 'Yuqori lyuk qulfi'. → Alarm subtype: electronics-module service door / upper hatch opened.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: LED colour code reusable as status chips
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Holat LED': '60 × 3 mm chiziq: ko‘k — kutish, sariq — barmoq, yashil — ruxsat, qizil — qulf'. JS hex: idle/face #2f9bff (blue), finger #ffb547 (amber), ok/open #3ddc84 (green), lock #ff5252 (red). Caution: in 03 red = normally locked; for the admin dashboard reserve red for alarms and render 'qulflangan' as neutral, keeping the 03 mapping only inside a 'terminal mirror' widget.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Holat LED'; 03 JS drawScreen col map and setLeds calls

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: Terminal state machine idle → face → finger → ok → open → lock → idle
findings.detail: 03 JS auth object and tick(): face (~1.3 s), finger (~1.4 s), ok (0.7 s) then doors open, 'open' persists until door closed, lock (1.5 s) then idle. Lock is triggered by the door-closed sensor, not by a second press (03 JS comment 'the lock is driven by the door-closed sensor'). → Cabinet card shows current terminal state and time in state; real system adds 'karta' and 'PIN' states per 01 §2.5/§4.2.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: Display texts reusable as status labels
findings.detail: 03 JS drawScreen msg map: idle 'Yuzingizni kameraga qarating'; face 'Yuz tanilmoqda… N %'; finger 'Barmoq izini beshikka qo‘ying'; ok 'Ruxsat · Xodim #01' / 'Chapga qadam qo‘ying, eshikni oching'; open 'Eshiklar ochiq' / 'Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi'; lock 'Qulflandi'. Header 'SMART SHKAF', top-right 'OCHIQ' or 'QULF'. Progress bar during face/finger.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: 3.5″ display content = holat, ko‘rsatmalar, xodim ID
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Displey': '3,5″ (74 × 56 mm), pol sathidan ≈1390 mm — holat, ko‘rsatmalar ("chapga qadam qo‘ying, eshikni oching"), xodim ID'. → Admin panel 'terminal mirror' shows the same three fields; xodim ID should be tabel raqami/F.I.Sh. (01 §3.4), not '#01'.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: Two independent sub-permissions and four lock points per cabinet
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Beshik va qisqich': 'PM qutisi va stvol qulfi — ikkita alohida ruxsat (avtomat / to‘pponcha)'; 02 §5.4 same. Lock points in 03: stvol qulfi solenoid (AK), PM qutisi elektron qulf, o‘q-dori qutisi qulf kamari solenoid ('PM qutisi ruxsati'), AK magazin uyasi qulflanadigan qopqoq. → Cabinet detail shows main door + 4 sub-lock states and which permission (avtomat/to‘pponcha) is granted to the officer.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Beshik va qisqich' and 'Xavfsizlik'; 03 JS lines ~501, 548, 556, 557; 02 §5.4

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Olish harakati': rifle removable only with door ≥ 90° and lock open; 'Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi'. 02 §3: 'eshik yopilishida avtomat avval joyiga qaytadi (interlok)'. → Status fields: door angle/open, rifle present (holat datchigi), 'avtomat tashqarida' state blocking auto-lock; door-left-open alarm (01 §3.4) uses these.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: Embed the 3D viewer as the cabinet visual model
findings.detail: User decision (2): the interactive viewer is the cabinet's visual model. 03 offers views Izometriya/Old/Yon/Ust/Ichki, door slider 0–100°, hover tooltips with part role, BOM table with row selection. → Cabinet detail can embed the viewer (door state driven by live sensor) or a static render; BOM table style reusable for inventory lists.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.topic: Interior LED strips as a minor telemetry item
findings.detail: 03 JS ~535: two 12 V interior LED strips 'Face ID / eshik datchigi orqali yonadi'. → Optional field in cabinet detail (ichki yoritish: yoniq/o‘chiq); not a KPI.

findings.section: G. Cabinet status widget — visual conventions from 03
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Barmoq izi': 'qo‘lqopda ishlamaydi — karta/PIN zaxira usuli ko‘zda tutilsin.' 01 §4.2 callout: primary card + fingerprint or PIN; Face ID additional. → Report: kirish usuli distribution per unit/season to detect biometric failure rates.

01 §1.2 zones: Pastki 0–1150 mm (AK-74, taktik sumka); O‘rta 1150–1450 (o‘q-dori qutisi yoki bronjilet); Yuqori-o‘rta 1450–1700 (PM, magazinlar, kishan, kichik jihozlar); Yuqori 1700–1950 (dubulg‘a, gaz niqobi); Texnik 1950–2000 (kabel, LED, datchiklar). → Cabinet detail renders a vertical slot map with per-slot presence.

01 §4.3: RFID for weapons/magazines/important equipment; vazn datchigi for magazine/ammo compartments (occupancy + weight change, advisory only); AK-74: qo‘ndoq ostidagi bosim datchigi + stvol qisqichi holat datchigi + RFID, 'Kritik holat kamida ikki turdagi signal bilan tasdiqlanadi'. 01 §4.5: 'qurol mavjudligi uchun mustaqil holat datchigi'. → Item row shows which sensors agree (e.g. 2/3) and flags conflicts as inventory discrepancy.

01 §2.5: 'Qaytarishda aynan biriktirilgan jihozlar joyiga qo‘yilgani tekshiriladi.' 01 §4.4: 'Qaytarishda aynan tegishli qurol tekshiriladi.' → Return event carries a check result; mismatch → discrepancy record + alert to mas’ul shaxs.

01 §4.1 Armory System: 'qurol holati, ko‘rik, ta’mir va majburiy ish jarayonlari'; 01 §4.4 re-issue blocked until inspected/repaired; 01 §3.4 status enum mavjud/yo‘q/nosoz/xizmatda. → Weapon screen: status, last inspection date, next due, repair tickets; list 'ko‘rikdan o‘tmagan qurollar'.

01 §4.3 RFID: 'olish-qaytarishni avtomatlashtirish va tez inventarizatsiya qilish imkonini beradi.' → Screen: start inventory for qurolxona/unit, live progress, list of differences (expected vs detected), sign-off by mas’ul shaxs; results feed KPI 'inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar'.

findings.topic: Storage condition of the rifle affects what 'complete' means
findings.detail: 03 aside 'AK-74 uyasi' / 02 §5.2: rifle stored 'magazinsiz, bo‘sh, saqlagichda'; ammunition in a separate locked steel box; 4 AK magazines in lockable slot; PM + 2 magazines in separate locked box. → Inventory completeness check = rifle + N magazines + ammo box (partiya, count) + PM + PM magazines, each independently sensed.
01 §3.6: 'hodisalar jurnali uzoq muddat saqlanadi'. → No automatic purge of journal rows; archive tier only. Exact term to be confirmed with customer (01 §5.1 'Saqlash').

findings.topic: Biometric templates stored protected and never shown
findings.detail: 01 §3.6: 'Face ID biometrik shabloni himoyalangan shaklda saqlanadi'; 01 §5 TZ section 'axborot xavfsizligi va biometrik ma’lumotlarni himoya qilish'. → Admin panel shows only enrollment status (Face ID: ro‘yxatdan o‘tgan/yo‘q, barmoq izi: n ta), never raw templates or face images; role-restricted enrollment action.
01 §3.6: 'oddiy kirish videosi cheklangan muddat saqlanadi'. → Retention setting per class; event detail shows 'video o‘chirilgan (muddat tugagan)' when expired.
01 §3.6: 'buzishga urinish videosi alohida arxivlanadi'. → Alarm detail links to archive; archive excluded from purge jobs.

findings.topic: Data residency: local server in Uzbekistan, offline-first, no cloud
findings.detail: 01 §3.6: 'ma’lumotlar O‘zbekiston hududidagi mahalliy serverda saqlanadi'; 01 §4.6: 'IIVning lokal serveri va offline-first ish' vs cloud dependence. → Deployment/about screen states server location; no external CDN/cloud calls in the admin panel.

findings.topic: Retention settings screen with per-class periods
findings.detail: 01 §5.1 'Saqlash': 'Jurnal, biometrika va videoni saqlash muddati hamda arxiv talabi' must be obtained from the customer. → Settings screen with configurable retention for: jurnal, oddiy video, buzish videosi (archive), biometrika, with audit of changes (06 'Аудит системных правок').

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.detail: 01 §4.7: Har bir shkaf (elektron qulf, RFID/ID, holat datchiklari, ESP32/STM32 kontroller); Har 10–20 shkaf (Face ID terminali, ekran, aloqa/boshqaruv moduli); Har bir qurolxona (lokal kontroller, UPS, hodisalar keshi, tarmoq shlyuzi); Tashkilot serveri; Hudud/respublika. → 'Qurilmalar' screen as a tree with health per node.

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.detail: 01 concept table 'Offline ishlash': 'Markaziy tarmoq uzilganda mahalliy ruxsatlar va jurnal ishlashda davom etadi'; 01 §4.5: 'internet bo‘lmasa lokal ishlash va keyin sinxronlash'; 01 §4.7 'hodisalar keshi'. → Per cabinet/armory: online/offline, last heartbeat, queued (unsynced) event count, last sync time; journal rows tagged 'offline yozilgan, keyin sinxronlangan'.

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.detail: 01 §1.4: 'Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat'; 01 §4.7 UPS per qurolxona; 02 §5.4 / 03 aside 'Ichki joy': DC-UPS + 12.8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 ≈ 5 h. → Fields: mains/UPS, battery %, estimated runtime, last power event; alarm 'quvvat uzilishi' (01 §3.4).

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.topic: Cabinet technical status = sensor health list
findings.detail: 01 §3.4 Shkaf 'texnik holati'; sensors from 01 §1.4 (eshik holati, urilish, buzish) and 01 §4.3 (RFID, vazn, bosim/holat). → Cabinet detail tab 'Texnik holat': each sensor/lock OK/nosoz, last reading time; feeds 'nosoz shkaflar' KPI.

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.detail: 03 aside 'Muhit': IP54 module, 30–60 W heat, heater below 5 °C; 01 §5.1 'Muhit' asks about harorat, namlik. → Optional temperature/humidity fields per module; not a prototype KPI.

findings.section: J. Device health and offline status
findings.topic: Block/unblock cabinet action with reason and audit
findings.detail: 01 §2.4 qurolxona mas’uli 'shkafni ... bloklaydi'; 01 §3.5 'bloklangan shkaflar'. → Action dialog: reason (nosozlik, xodim holati, tekshiruv, boshqa), comment; recorded as system event; cabinet card shows 'Bloklangan' badge.

findings.topic: Integration settings: HR, duty roster, access control, video
findings.detail: 01 §4.5: 'mavjud HR, navbatchilik va kirish nazorati tizimlari bilan API integratsiyasi'; 01 §4.6: 'Mavjud xizmat kartasi va ichki bazalar bilan integratsiya'; 01 §5.1 Integratsiya: xodimlar bazasi, xizmat kartasi, navbatchilik, videokuzatuv. → Integration screen with connector status; officer profile fields marked as HR-sourced vs local.

01 §2.5: system checks 'xizmat navbati, lavozim va amaldagi ruxsat'; 01 §4.1 Traka: 'vaqt bo‘yicha vakolat'. → Screen 'Navbatchilik jadvali': shifts per unit, officers on shift; permission valid within shift window; expected return time defaults to shift end (basis for Kechikish).
01 §2.4 navbatchi/komandir manages 'vaqtinchalik vakolat'. → Record: officer, cabinet(s), valid from/to, granted by, reason, auto-expiry; list of active temporary authorities on dashboard.

01 §4.2 callout: 'Asosiy: xizmat kartasi + barmoq izi yoki PIN. Qo‘shimcha: Face ID. Favqulodda: vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit.'; 01 §4.2 list includes 'yuqori xavfli operatsiyada ikki xodim tasdig‘i'; 01 concept 'Ikki bosqichli tasdiqlash'. → Settings per armory: required factor combination, Face ID enabled, two-person rule for emergency/mass opening.

findings.topic: Legal principle: system verifies, does not create authority
findings.detail: 01 §2.2 callout: 'Smart shkaf bu vakolatni yaratmaydi — faqat mavjud vakolatni texnik jihatdan tekshiradi va qayd etadi.' → Officer profile must reference the granting order (buyruq raqami/sana) and eligibility checks; UI wording avoids 'grant weapon right', uses 'ruxsatni qayd etish'.

findings.topic: Armory-level alarm integration and responsible person
findings.detail: 01 §1.3: cabinet does not replace 'qurolxona, jismoniy qo‘riqlash va signalizatsiya'; responsible person is appointed for storage/issue/receipt/accounting. → Qurolxona record: address, mas’ul shaxs, guard post contact, optional link to building alarm; alarms routed to guard post (02 §6 'qorovul posti').

findings.topic: Admin panel is a named TZ section
findings.detail: 01 §5: TZ will include 'dasturiy ta’minot, rollar, jurnal va dashboard' and 'lokal tarmoq, server va API integratsiyasi'. → The screen catalogue feeds that TZ section directly.

findings.topic: Modes 'Сбор' (muster) and 'Тревога' (alarm) to shorten arming time
findings.detail: 06: 'Режим «Сбор» и «Тревога» — оптимизация процесса выдачи оружия значительно сокращает время вооружения личного состава.' 01 §2.6 defines the only mass action: 'Favqulodda ommaviy ochish' by navbatchi/qurolxona mas’uli/komandir with card + special PIN, optionally two-person, logged in the separate journal. → Panel action 'Ommaviy ochish (Trevoga)' following §2.6; 'Sbor' as a planned mass-issue window that pre-approves shift permissions rather than opening doors.

findings.topic: During a mode, readiness widget becomes the primary view
findings.detail: 06 pairs the modes with 'Мониторинг готовности 24/7' (who is armed). → Mode screen shows live count of armed vs pending officers, per-cabinet progress, elapsed time since mode start.

01 §3.3: 20 cabinets × 400 mm = 8 m; two walls of 10 → ~4 m per side with 1.2–1.5 m aisle; one Face ID terminal per 10–20 cabinets. → Optional armory layout view: rows of cabinet tiles grouped by terminal, status colour per tile.

01 §1.1: shkaf 2000 × 400 × 600 mm, module 150–200 mm, complex 2000 × 600 × 600; 01 §1.4: ≥2 mm steel body, 3 mm door frame/lock zone, single metal door, electronic + mechanical emergency lock, 2× M12 floor anchors, M8–M10 wall. → Static 'Model/spec' tab on cabinet type screen uses these values.

contradictions.issue: Door type and the glass-break alarm: 02 §5.5/§6 and 03 (header, aside 'Oynali eshik', META.windows/glass) describe a glazed door with two viewing windows and a 'shisha sinishi datchigi + 3 o‘qli akselerometr' detection chain; 01 §1.5 callout says a full-glass outer door is a certification risk and 'Eng xavfsiz variant — metall tashqi eshik va ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko‘rsatish'.
contradictions.sources: 02 §5.5, §6; 03 aside 'Oynali eshik', META.windows/glass; 01 §1.5 callout 'OYNALI ESHIK BO‘YICHA XAVF'
contradictions.resolution: 01 + user decision: metal door. Drop 'glass break' from alarm types; keep impact/accelerometer and tamper (01 §1.4). Because the interior is no longer visible through glass, the admin panel's cabinet detail (sensor slot map, optional interior camera frame) is the 'ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko‘rsatish' that 01 calls for.

contradictions.issue: Role model: 06 shows three roles (Сотрудник, Оператор, Администратор); 01 §2.4 defines five (Oddiy xodim, Qurolxona mas’uli, Navbatchi/komandir, Administrator, Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat).
contradictions.resolution: Use 01's five roles. 06 'Оператор' (journal of all actions, monitoring and confirmation) splits into Qurolxona mas’uli and Navbatchi/komandir; 06 'Администратор' (technical setup, audit of system edits) matches 01 Administrator, who per 01 has no weapon authority; 01 adds Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat as a read-only reporting role absent from 06.

contradictions.issue: Unit of monitoring: 06 depicts a multi-cell locker bank with a 'персональная ячейка' per officer and cell-level hardware control; 01 §4.6 explicitly localises away from 'Har bir qurol uchun alohida kichik bo‘lim' to 'Bir xodimning qurol va asosiy jihozlari bitta vertikal shkafda'.
contradictions.sources: 06 central illustration and 'Аппаратный контроль ячеек'; 01 §4.6 Mahalliylashtiriladigan farqlar
contradictions.resolution: 01: the monitored unit is the cabinet (= one officer). The 'cells' of 06 become the cabinet's sub-locks in the status widget (stvol qulfi, PM qutisi, o‘q-dori kamari, magazin uyasi per 03), not separate lockers.

contradictions.issue: Authentication sequence shown on the terminal: 03 animates Face ID → fingerprint → unlock (aside note and JS states face/finger); 01 §4.2 callout recommends primary 'xizmat kartasi + barmoq izi yoki PIN', Face ID only as additional, and 01 §2.5 starts with 'xizmat kartasi yoki Face ID'.
contradictions.sources: 03 aside note and JS auth states; 01 §4.2 callout; 01 §2.5
contradictions.resolution: 01: the terminal-mirror widget and access-method enum must include card and PIN states in addition to 03's face/finger; keep 03's colour/message conventions but add 'Kartani tuting' and 'PIN kiriting' states. Statistics on kirish usuli should treat Face ID as optional.

contradictions.issue: Colour semantics of red: 03 LED/display use red for the normal locked state ('qizil — qulf'), while 06 uses red figures for 'not armed/attention' and dashboards conventionally use red for alarms.
contradictions.sources: 03 aside 'Holat LED', JS setLeds(0xff5252) in lock state; 06 readiness mockup
contradictions.resolution: For the admin dashboard use red only for alarms/overdue/blocked; show 'qulflangan' as neutral. Reuse the 03 palette verbatim only in a widget that mirrors the physical terminal.

contradictions.issue: Mass/rapid issuance: 06 introduces modes 'Сбор' and 'Тревога'; 01 only defines 'Favqulodda ommaviy ochish' (§2.6) with strict authorisation and a separate journal, and says nothing about a muster mode.
contradictions.resolution: Implement 'Тревога' as 01 §2.6 emergency mass opening. 'Сбор' is not in 01; treat it as a planned mass-issue window (pre-approved shift permissions, no automatic door opening) and flag it for customer confirmation.

contradictions.issue: Connectivity per cabinet: 02 §5.4 and 03 aside 'Aloqa va EMC' put an LTE router and external antenna in every electronics module; 01 §3.3 and §4.7 put the comms/control module per 10–20 cabinets and a network gateway per armory, with a local IIV server (§4.6).
contradictions.resolution: 01: model online/offline and sync status at armory-gateway and terminal-group level, with per-cabinet controller heartbeat over the local network; LTE is at most a backup uplink for the armory, not a per-cabinet attribute.

contradictions.issue: Cabinet dimensions and mass in 02/03 (400 × 646 × 2056 mm, ≈223 kg + module 110–150 kg) vs 01 §1.1 (2000 × 400 × 600 mm; complex 2000 × 600 × 600).
contradictions.resolution: 01 values go on any spec/model card in the admin panel; 02/03 numbers are viewer-model artefacts.

contradictions.issue: Officer identifier on the terminal display: 03 shows 'Xodim #01'; 01 §3.4 identifies officers by tabel raqami and F.I.Sh.
contradictions.resolution: Display and widgets show tabel raqami (and name where privacy policy allows); '#01' is a mock placeholder.

gaps: Retention periods are not numeric anywhere: 01 §3.6 says journal 'uzoq muddat', ordinary video 'cheklangan muddat', tamper video archived; 01 §5.1 'Saqlash' explicitly defers the terms to the customer. Safe default for the prototype: journal never purged, ordinary video 30 days, tamper video indefinitely, all configurable in a retention settings screen.

Late-return threshold ('belgilangan vaqt', 01 §3.4 Kechikish) is undefined. Safe default: expected return = end of the officer's shift (01 §2.5 navbat) plus a configurable grace period; per-issuance override by navbatchi.

Denied-access lockout policy: 01 §3.4 records 'urinishlar soni' but no threshold or lockout behaviour is given. Safe default: alert after N (e.g. 3) consecutive denials, temporary cabinet block requiring qurolxona mas’uli unblock, configurable.

Number of confirmers for emergency/mass opening: 01 §2.6 says 'zarur holatda ikki mas’ul shaxs tasdig‘i' and 01 §5.1 'Vakolat' lists it as a customer question. Safe default: two-person confirmation required for mass opening, single authorised person for a single-cabinet emergency, configurable.

Semantics of 06's 'Сбор' mode (muster) are not defined in 01; only 'Тревога'-like emergency mass opening is. Needs customer confirmation whether a muster mode should pre-open doors or only pre-authorise.

Video source for the 'event ↔ video' linkage (06) is unspecified: 01 §5.1 lists 'videokuzatuv tizimlari' as an integration question, and 03 only has the Face ID camera. Prototype default: store Face ID terminal snapshots per event; CCTV linkage deferred.

Exact IIV administrative hierarchy names/levels for the region rollup (01 §4.7 gives only 'Hudud/respublika'; 01 §2.1 lists unit types). Safe default: respublika → viloyat → tuman/shahar IIB or functional bo‘linma → qurolxona → shkaf.

Whether ordinary officers get any web login: 01 §2.4 limits them to their own cabinet; 06 shows only biometric/video control for them. Safe default: no web login in the prototype; optional read-only 'Mening shkafim' later.

Identification method for helmet, body armour, gas mask, handcuffs, tactical bag: 01 §2.3 gives inventory numbers only for dubulg‘a/bronjilet and a serial for body camera. Safe default: inventory number, optional RFID tag, presence not sensor-verified unless RFID present.

Inventory count (inventarizatsiya) cadence and procedure are not defined; 01 §4.3 only says RFID enables fast counts. Safe default: on-demand run by qurolxona mas’uli plus a configurable scheduled run.

Weight-sensor thresholds and tolerance for magazine/ammo compartments (01 §4.3 says advisory only). Safe default: show weight delta and flag deviations beyond a configurable percentage; never derive round counts.
KPI granularity for 'jami va mavjud qurollar' (per weapon type vs total) is not stated in 01 §3.5. Safe default: per type (AK-74, PM) with a total.
Script for the Uzbek UI (Latin vs Cyrillic) is not stated; all sources use Latin. Safe default: Latin.
Whether region/republic users may see officer names (privacy) versus aggregates only; 01 §4.7 says 'vakolat doirasida'. Safe default: aggregates at region level, names at unit level.
No hardware exists (stage: prototype 1–2 units per 01 §3.2), so all sensor-derived fields (presence, weight, door angle, UPS) need a simulator/mock feed for the admin panel prototype.

findings.detail: Each cabinet carries: electronic lock, RFID/ID reader, state sensors ('holat datchiklari') and an ESP32/STM32-class controller ('ESP32/STM32 sinfidagi kontroller'). NFR: the cabinet controller is the minimal trusted endpoint — it owns the lock driver, door/tamper/weapon-presence sensors and a local event buffer; it must not depend on the shared terminal to keep the lock secure.

findings.topic: Architecture level 2 — shared terminal per 10–20 cabinets
findings.detail: One Face ID terminal, one screen and one shared communication/control module ('umumiy aloqa/boshqaruv moduli') serve 10–20 cabinets. NFR: the data model must have a 'terminal' entity with a 1:N relation to cabinets; an authentication session at a terminal results in an unlock command targeted at exactly one cabinet (01 §2.5 'faqat tegishli shkaf ochiladi').

Each armory ('qurolxona') has a local controller, UPS, event cache ('hodisalar keshi') and network gateway ('tarmoq shlyuzi'). NFR: this is the offline-first node (Raspberry Pi default): it holds the local permission cache, buffers events while WAN is down, and is the only device that talks to the organization server.

Organization server: central database, permissions ('ruxsatlar'), audit and dashboard. This is the admin panel's backend (FastAPI + SQLite prototype / PostgreSQL pilot). NFR: it is the system of record for assignments, permissions and the consolidated audit log; armory nodes sync to it.

Region/republic level: aggregated monitoring and reporting 'vakolat doirasida' (within scope of authority). NFR: admin panel needs an organizational hierarchy (bo'linma → IIB → viloyat → respublika) with scoped read access; dashboards must roll up by 'hudud va bo'linmalar' (01 §3.5).

findings.topic: Electronics economy — shared module instead of per-cabinet module
findings.detail: A separate full-height electronics module on every cabinet 'joy va xarajatni oshiradi' (raises space and cost). Preferred: one shared Face ID terminal, local controller and comms module per 10–20 cabinets; each cabinet keeps only lock, identifier, sensors and a cheap local controller ('arzon mahalliy kontroller'). NFR: the server must not assume a 1:1 terminal:cabinet mapping; the 03 full-height module is the lab-prototype configuration.

20 cabinets × 400 mm = 8 m; installed 10 per wall on two walls → ≈4 m cabinet row per side plus a 1.2–1.5 m service aisle. NFR: cabinet record should carry armory, wall/row and position so the dashboard can render an armory map; a 'sinov' armory holds 10–20 cabinets (01 §3.2).

findings.topic: Localisation vs. international products — local server, offline-first
findings.detail: Table 'Xalqaro mahsulotlarda / Bizning konsepsiyada': cloud platform dependency → 'IIVning lokal serveri va offline-first ish'; imported electronics → locally assembled replaceable modules; foreign ID system → integration with existing service card and internal databases; import service → local service and spare parts. NFR: no cloud dependency; all software must run on-premises inside IIV network.

findings.topic: System class: weapons management system, not a smart locker
findings.detail: Closing note: the product is 'oddiy Face IDli shkaf emas' — it manages the employee↔weapon↔equipment binding, records issue/return automatically, works offline and connects to central control. International analogues are 'Intelligent Weapons Management System / Electronic Armory Management System' whose core is the 'chain of custody' history (who, when, what, returned when).
findings.source: 01 §4 intro + 'XALQARO TAJRIBA BO‘YICHA YAKUN' box after §4.7

findings.detail: Prototip: company lab, 1–2 cabinets (mechanics + electronics test); Sinov: one armory, 10–20 (real process); Pilot: one IIB/special unit, 30–50 ('to‘liq apparat-dasturiy tizim'); Hududiy pilot: one viloyat, 300–500 ('lokal server, integratsiya va statistika'); Respublika: 5 000+. Most practical start: 30–50 cabinets in one unit. NFR: the admin panel must be sized for 50 cabinets at pilot, 500 at regional pilot, with a migration path (SQLite → PostgreSQL) before the regional pilot.

Formula: 'Shkaflar soni = qurol biriktirilgan xodimlar soni + 5–10% zaxira'. Scenarios: small IIB 22; medium IIB 55; large unit 110; one viloyat pilot 550; first republic stage 5 500; extended 11 000; large national system 27 500. Figures are planning scenarios, not official staffing. NFR: identifiers and hierarchy must scale to tens of thousands of cabinets; per-cabinet reserve cabinets (unassigned) are a normal state.

5 000 cabinets × ~4 events/day = 20 000 events/day ≈ 7 300 000/year. Text journal is small; permanent storage of video and face images sharply increases storage. NFR: event table partitioned by time; video/face media kept out of the relational DB and subject to retention policies.

'hodisalar jurnali uzoq muddat saqlanadi' (long-term event log); Face ID biometric template stored in protected form; ordinary access video kept for a limited period; tamper-attempt video archived separately; all data stored on a local server in Uzbekistan. NFR: four distinct retention classes (events: long-term; biometric templates: protected, lifecycle tied to employee; normal video: short TTL; tamper video: separate archive, no auto-purge). Exact periods are a customer input (01 §5.1 'Saqlash').

Concept table: 'Offline ishlash — Markaziy tarmoq uzilganda mahalliy ruxsatlar va jurnal ishlashda davom etadi.' NFR: the armory node must be able to authorize openings and log events with no connectivity to the organization server; permissions are replicated down, events are replicated up.

Adopted solution: 'internet bo‘lmasa lokal ishlash va keyin sinxronlash'. NFR: store-and-forward with idempotent event upload (unique event ID per cabinet + monotonically increasing sequence number) so that reconnection never duplicates or drops journal entries.

Armory level includes 'hodisalar keshi' (event cache) and UPS. NFR: cache must survive power loss (UPS + persistent storage) and hold at least several days of events (e.g. 50 cabinets × 4 events × 7 days ≈ 1 400 events — trivial in size, so size the cache generously).

findings.topic: Authorization check needs duty roster data locally
findings.detail: Normal scenario step 3: 'Tizim xizmat navbati, lavozim va amaldagi ruxsatni tekshiradi' (checks duty shift, position and current permission) before opening. NFR: duty roster and permission state must be cached on the armory node so the check works offline; central revocation must propagate as soon as the link returns.

Binding table: 'Kirish huquqi — Xizmat kartasi + biometrika/PIN + xizmat holati' (service card + biometrics/PIN + service status). NFR: authorization = identity (card/face) AND verification (fingerprint/PIN) AND status (active employee, on duty, not suspended); each of the three must be evaluated and logged separately.

Adopted solution: 'mavjud HR, navbatchilik va kirish nazorati tizimlari bilan API integratsiyasi' (integration with existing HR, duty-roster and access-control systems). NFR: admin panel exposes/consumes REST APIs for employee master data (HR), shift schedule (navbatchilik) and card/access-control system; the system must still operate on manually entered data when integrations are absent (prototype).

findings.topic: Integration inventory to clarify with customer
findings.detail: Row 'Integratsiya': 'Mavjud xodimlar bazasi, xizmat kartasi, navbatchilik va videokuzatuv tizimlari' — existing employee database, service card, duty roster and video surveillance systems must be identified before the TZ. NFR: design integration as adapters behind stable internal interfaces so the concrete IIV systems can be plugged in later.

06: 'каждое открытие и наличие оружия фиксируется датчиками и синхронизируется с видеозаписью' (every opening and weapon presence recorded by sensors and synchronized with video). 01 §3.6 distinguishes ordinary access video (limited retention) from tamper video (archived). NFR: each event record carries a timestamp precise enough to look up a video clip; optional link/clip reference field; video system integration is a customer input (01 §5.1).

'Xorijiy identifikatsiya tizimi' → 'Mavjud xizmat kartasi va ichki bazalar bilan integratsiya'. NFR: card identifier format/technology is external — store card UID as opaque string, support re-issuing/blocking a card without deleting the employee.

'Shkaf raqami, xodim tabel raqami va jihoz identifikatorlari yagona elektron profilga bog‘lanadi' — cabinet number, employee tabel number and equipment IDs are linked into one electronic profile. Binding methods: AK-74 and PM by serial number + RFID; magazines by inventory number + quantity; ammunition by type, calibre, batch and count; helmet/body armour by inventory number; body camera by device serial. NFR: profile = employee + cabinet + item set, with history (who was bound when).

Adopted solution: 'o‘chirib bo‘lmaydigan audit jurnali' (unerasable audit journal); §4.4: event is written to a 'himoyalangan audit jurnaliga' (protected audit journal). NFR: append-only event store; no UPDATE/DELETE privileges for application roles; hash-chained records or signed batches so tampering is detectable; corrections are new events referencing the original.

Concept table: 'To‘liq audit — Har bir ochish, olish, qaytarish, rad etish va favqulodda operatsiya qayd etiladi.' NFR: event types minimum: door open/close, item taken/returned, access denied, emergency open, plus technical events (power, tamper, mechanical key).

'Har bir favqulodda ochilish o‘chirib bo‘lmaydigan alohida jurnalga yoziladi' — every emergency opening goes into a separate unerasable journal. Emergency mass opening only by authorized navbatchi, qurolxona mas'uli or komandir; recommended: authorized card + special PIN, and two-person confirmation when required. NFR: emergency events have their own table/view with elevated retention, record both approvers, and trigger alerts.

06: 'При сбое питания ячейки остаются заблокированными, а все действия пишутся в неизменяемый журнал' (on power failure cells stay locked; all actions written to an immutable journal). Consistent with user default fail-secure lock + mechanical key. NFR: server must reflect 'locked, unpowered' as a distinct cabinet state; no remote unlock path exists without power.
findings.source: 06 infographic, block 'Принцип Fail-secure и цифровой аудит'

findings.detail: Construction requirement: 'Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat; mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi.' NFR: mechanical-override detection (key-switch or bolt sensor) generates a distinct high-priority event; the emergency authentication chain in §4.2 is 'vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit'.

'Eshik holati, urilish va buzishga urinish datchiklari' (door state, impact and tamper-attempt sensors) are baseline construction requirements; 'Qurol va o‘q-dori holati mustaqil nazorat qilinadi' (weapon and ammunition state monitored independently). NFR: alarm channel from cabinet to server is separate from the normal event channel and has higher priority.

Statistics row 'Signal': 'Urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi va quvvat uzilishi' (impact, break-in, door left open, power loss). NFR: these four are mandatory alarm types in the admin panel's alarm module with acknowledgement workflow.

'Rad etilgan kirish — Kim, qachon, sababi va urinishlar soni' (who, when, reason, attempt count). NFR: denial events store reason code (no duty shift, blocked cabinet, biometric mismatch, wrong PIN, item not passed inspection, etc.) and a running attempt counter; a lockout threshold is not given in the sources (engineer default).

'Face ID biometrik shabloni himoyalangan shaklda saqlanadi' — the face template is stored in protected form; TZ section 'axborot xavfsizligi va biometrik ma’lumotlarni himoya qilish'. NFR: raw face images are not retained after enrolment; templates encrypted at rest with keys separate from the DB; templates never leave the IIV network; fingerprint templates same treatment (01 §4.2 primary factor).

'ma’lumotlar O‘zbekiston hududidagi mahalliy serverda saqlanadi' — data is stored on a local server on Uzbek territory; §4.6 rejects cloud dependency in favour of 'IIVning lokal serveri'. NFR: no external SaaS, no CDN, no telemetry to third parties; the admin panel must be deployable fully on-prem including fonts/JS assets.

findings.topic: Separation of duties — administrator has no weapon rights
findings.detail: 'Administrator — Foydalanuvchi, tizim va elektronika sozlamalarini boshqaradi; qurol olish vakolati avtomatik berilmaydi' (administrator manages users, system and electronics settings; weapon-taking authority is not automatically granted). NFR: RBAC where technical roles cannot open cabinets or approve emergency openings; granting weapon authority requires the order-based binding by qurolxona mas'uli/komandir.

06 gives the Администратор role 'аудит системных правок' (audit of system edits) and 'техническая настройка'. NFR: every change to users, roles, cabinet assignments, permissions and device settings is itself an audit event (who, what, before/after).

findings.topic: Elimination of the human factor / forgery of paper journals
findings.detail: 06: 'Автоматизация исключает ошибки ручного ввода и подделку записей в бумажных журналах.' NFR: events are generated by devices, not typed by people; manual entries (e.g. armourer registering an item) are flagged as manual and attributed.

findings.topic: Lock driver stays inside the cabinet; module sends only authenticated signal
findings.detail: 'qulf yuritmasi (relelar) va qulf quvvat chiqishi shkafning himoyalangan hajmi ichida qoladi — modul faqat autentifikatsiyalangan (shifrlangan) signal yuboradi, shuning uchun modulni ochib qulfni tutashtirib bo‘lmaydi'. Also 02 §5.4 and 03 cabinet 'Xavfsizlik': 'PM qutisi va stvol qulfi solenoidlari shkaf ichida, modul faqat signal beradi'. NFR for cabinet↔terminal↔server link: unlock commands must be authenticated and encrypted end-to-end to the cabinet controller (per-device key, replay protection via nonce/sequence); shorting wires at the module or terminal must not unlock.

'lyuklarda tamper-datchiklar, buzishga chidamli ilmoqlar; eshikning oshiq-moshiq tomonida buzishga qarshi shtiftlar' — tamper sensors on service hatches, tamper-resistant hinges, anti-tamper pins on the door hinge side. Service door 155×1150 has key + seal ('kalit va zichlagich'); upper hatch 155×200 for LTE router. NFR: hatch-open events are logged and alarmed; planned maintenance mode lets an administrator suppress the alarm for a bounded time, recorded in the audit.
findings.source: 03 <aside> items 'Xavfsizlik' (module), 'Xizmat kirishi'; 03 JS addBox roles for SERVICE_DOOR/UPPER_HATCH

findings.topic: Detection chain: sensor → module → guard post
findings.detail: Glass-door analysis concluded protection is detection, not delay: 'shisha sinishi datchigi + 3 o‘qli akselerometr → elektronika moduli → qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE) va qo‘riqlanadigan qurol xonasi'. With the metal door decision the glass-break sensor drops, but 01 §1.4 keeps impact ('urilish') and tamper sensors (3-axis accelerometer remains a reasonable implementation). NFR: alarm reaches the guard post ('qorovul posti') within seconds, with LTE as the fallback path when LAN is down; alarm is journaled locally even if the server is unreachable.

findings.topic: Two independent signals for critical states
findings.detail: 'Kritik holat kamida ikki turdagi signal bilan tasdiqlanadi' — critical state confirmed by at least two signal types (AK-74: pressure sensor under stock, barrel-clamp state sensor, RFID). Weight sensor 'yuridik dalil sifatida aniq tasdiqlamaydi' (is not legal proof of round count) but adds an inventory signal. NFR: server stores raw per-sensor readings plus a derived 'weapon present/absent' state with confidence; single-sensor disagreements produce a warning, not a false 'taken' event.
findings.source: 01 §4.3 'Qurol va jihozlarni aniqlash' (RFID / Vazn datchigi / Mexanik-holat datchigi)

findings.detail: 'Asosiy: xizmat kartasi + barmoq izi yoki PIN. Qo‘shimcha: Face ID. Favqulodda: vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit. Faqat Face IDga tayanish niqob, dubulg‘a, yorug‘lik va kamera nosozligi sababli tavsiya etilmaydi.' Identification methods list: RFID service card, personal PIN, fingerprint, Face ID, central permission system, two-person confirmation for high-risk operations. NFR: authentication policy is configurable per cabinet group; the server records which factors were used ('Kirish usuli': karta, PIN, biometrika, favqulodda).
findings.source: 01 §4.2 'Xodimni aniqlash' + box 'TAVSIYA ETILADIGAN AUTENTIFIKATSIYA'; 01 §3.4 row 'Kirish usuli'

findings.detail: 1) employee identified by service card or Face ID; 2) confirmed by fingerprint or PIN; 3) system checks duty shift, position and current permission; 4) if permitted, only the relevant cabinet opens; 5) removal of weapon/equipment recorded by sensors; 6) date, time, employee and weapon serial written to journal; 7) on return, verification that exactly the bound items are in place; 8) door closes and cabinet auto-locks. NFR: cabinet state machine on server: locked → identifying → verifying → authorized/denied → unlocked → open → (items out) → open → closed → locked; each transition is an event.

JS states: idle → face → finger → ok → open → lock; screen messages 'Yuzingizni kameraga qarating', 'Yuz tanilmoqda… %', 'Barmoq izini beshikka qo‘ying', 'Ruxsat · Xodim #01 / Chapga qadam qo‘ying, eshikni oching', 'Eshiklar ochiq / Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi', 'Qulflandi'. Locking is triggered by the door-closed sensor, not by a second press ('the lock is driven by the door-closed sensor'). LED: blue wait, yellow finger, green permission, red lock. NFR: add card/PIN/denied/emergency states per 01 §2.5/§4.2; keep sensor-driven relock.

'qo‘lqopda ishlamaydi — karta/PIN zaxira usuli ko‘zda tutilsin' (does not work with gloves — provide card/PIN backup). NFR: PIN stored only as salted hash; PIN fallback events are distinguishable from biometric events in the journal.

findings.topic: Two separate permissions per cabinet: rifle and pistol
findings.detail: 'PM qutisi va stvol qulfi — ikkita alohida ruxsat (avtomat / to‘pponcha)'; ammo-can strap solenoid is tied to the 'PM qutisi ruxsati'. 02 §5.4: 'avtomat va PM qutisi uchun ikkita alohida ruxsat'. NFR: permissions are per compartment/lock within a cabinet (door, AK barrel lock, PM box, ammo strap, magazine bay), not just per cabinet; the unlock command carries a lock-ID bitmask.

'Navbatchi yoki komandir — Xizmat ruxsatini tasdiqlaydi, vaqtinchalik vakolat va favqulodda ochishni boshqaradi.' NFR: permissions have validity windows (time-based authority, cf. Traka 'vaqt bo‘yicha vakolat' in 01 §4.1); temporary grants expire automatically and are audited.

06: 'Режим «Сбор» и «Тревога» — оптимизация процесса выдачи оружия значительно сокращает время вооружения личного состава'; '24/7 readiness: командование в реальном времени видит… кто из сотрудников вооружен, а кто — нет'. Maps to 01 §2.6 'favqulodda ommaviy ochish'. NFR: a mode switch (normal / sbor / trevoga) at armory or unit scope, activated only by authorized roles with two-person option, that pre-authorizes a defined list of cabinets and shows an arming progress board.

International workflow: 'Ko‘rik yoki ta’mirdan o‘tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi'; Armory System reference: 'ko‘rik, ta’mir va majburiy ish jarayonlari'. NFR: inventory item states (01 §3.4 'Mavjud, yo‘q, nosoz yoki xizmatda') gate authorization — item in 'nosoz'/'xizmatda' → cabinet compartment stays locked for that item.

'Kech qaytarilganda mas’ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi'; adopted solution 'kech qaytarish bo‘yicha ogohlantirish'; statistic 'Kechikish — Belgilangan vaqtda qaytarilmagan jihoz'. NFR: per-issue deadline (from shift end or explicit duration); scheduler on the server and, for offline resilience, on the armory node; notification to 'mas’ul shaxs' (responsible person per O'RQ-550).

'LTE uchun modul ustida SMA o‘tkazgichli tashqi antenna (po‘lat korpus ichida signal yo‘q)'; upper hatch hosts 'LTE router, antenna kirishi'; 02 §5.4 lists 'LTE router; … tashqi antenna'. NFR: WAN link may be LTE; server must tolerate NAT, intermittent connectivity and metered bandwidth (compact event payloads, no continuous video streaming over LTE). Under 01 §4.7 the LTE router logically belongs to the armory gateway, not every cabinet.
findings.source: 03 <aside> items 'Aloqa va EMC', 'Xizmat kirishi'; 03 JS addBox 'Tashqi LTE antenna'; 02 §5.4

findings.detail: Reader cables shielded, grounded at EMC gland, kept ≥50 mm from lock power cables, separate glands for signal and power ('signal va quvvat uchun alohida o‘tkazgichlar'); cables pass from module through the wall into the cabinet ('kabellar devor orqali shkaf ichiga o‘tadi'). NFR: cabinet↔terminal wiring is a wired, shielded link; wireless is not the design for the intra-armory bus.

findings.topic: Wired bus / LAN not specified in sources
findings.detail: 01 §4.7 names only 'umumiy aloqa/boshqaruv moduli' (shared comms module) and 'tarmoq shlyuzi' (network gateway); 01 §5.1 'Muhit' lists 'elektr, tarmoq' as customer inputs; TZ section 'lokal tarmoq, server va API integratsiyasi'. No source mentions RS-485, CAN, Ethernet, PoE, Wi-Fi, MQTT or TLS. Engineer default (no question needed): RS-485 or Ethernet from cabinet ESP32 to the armory Raspberry Pi; Ethernet from armory to server; LTE only as WAN fallback; TLS 1.2+/mTLS with per-device credentials.

Module: 'korpus germetik IP54… membranali bosim klapani; 30–60 W issiqlik… majburiy sovutish kerak emas; ombor 5 °C dan sovisa 30–50 W termostatli isitgich'. 01 §1.5: IEC 60529 for electronics enclosure IP rating; 01 §5.1 'Muhit': temperature, humidity, installation conditions to be provided by customer. NFR: controller telemetry should include enclosure temperature and heater/UPS status so the panel can show 'texnik holati' (01 §3.4 'Shkaf').

'24 V/150 W quvvat bloki, DIN DC-UPS, qulf yuritmasi relelari (TVS himoyasi bilan)… akkumulyator pastda tortmada — 12,8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 (181 × 77 × 167, ≈5 soat) yoki 2 × 12 V 9 Ah'. 02 §5.4: '24 V manba, DC-UPS + LiFePO4 20 A·soat'. NFR: battery state (voltage, on-battery flag, estimated runtime) is part of cabinet telemetry; 'quvvat uzilishi' alarm (01 §3.4) raised when mains is lost even if the battery still runs the lock.

findings.topic: UPS at armory level and backup power per cabinet
findings.detail: 01 §4.7 places the UPS with the armory local controller; 01 §1.4 requires 'Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat' for the cabinet. Layered: armory UPS keeps the gateway/terminal/local server alive; cabinet-level DC-UPS keeps lock controller and sensors alive. NFR: the server must distinguish 'armory on UPS' from 'cabinet on battery' and estimate remaining autonomy (≈5 h per 03).

'eshik qo‘lda ochiladi, elektr yuritma yo‘q'; 03 note: 'O‘ng eshikka elektr yuritma qo‘yilmasin — u qo‘lda ochiladi'; door has 100° stop, hydraulic closer. NFR: 'unlocked' and 'open' are different states; an 'unlocked but not opened within N s' timeout must relock and log (timeout value is an engineer default).
findings.source: 02 §5.4 'Ssenariy'; 03 <aside> note after spec list; 03 item 'Oynali eshik' (gidravlik yopgich)

findings.topic: Interior LED strips driven by reader/door sensor
findings.detail: Two 12 V interior LED strips 'Face ID / eshik datchigi orqali yonadi'. Minor NFR: lighting is a local controller output, not server-controlled.
findings.source: 03 <aside> item 'Oynali eshik' (Yoritish); 03 JS addCab LED roles

findings.detail: Civil and service weapons must be kept 'begona shaxslar kirishini istisno qiladigan… qulflanadigan seyf yoki metall shkafda'; legal entities keep them 'maxsus jihozlangan va texnik mustahkamlangan qurolxona ichida, qo‘riqlash-yong‘in signalizatsiyasi va boshqa himoya vositalari bilan'. Armory and storage place are named in the licensing process. NFR: the cabinet is a metal cabinet inside an armory; the admin panel must model the armory (with its guard/alarm status as external context) rather than treating cabinets as stand-alone safes.

'Qurol va o‘q-dorining saqlanishi, berilishi, qabul qilinishi va hisobi uchun mas’ul shaxs tayinlanadi.' NFR: the system must name a responsible person per armory/unit (maps to 'Qurolxona mas’uli' role); reports, late-return alerts and inventory discrepancies are addressed to this person; the electronic journal must be exportable as the accounting record this person signs off.

findings.topic: Smart cabinet does not replace armory, guard or alarm
findings.detail: 'Metall shkaf Smart tizim bo‘lsa ham, qurolxona, jismoniy qo‘riqlash va signalizatsiya talablarini almashtirmaydi.' NFR: the admin panel is an accounting/monitoring layer; it must integrate with (or at least not conflict with) the existing security-fire alarm; alarms from cabinets should be forwardable to the guard post/alarm panel (03 'qorovul posti').

findings.topic: Legal principle: cabinet verifies authority, does not create it
findings.detail: 'Xodimga qurol tashkilot rahbarining qarori, tegishli ruxsat va belgilangan tayyorgarlikdan o‘tganidan keyin beriladi. Smart shkaf bu vakolatni yaratmaydi — faqat mavjud vakolatni texnik jihatdan tekshiradi va qayd etadi.' Eligibility: weapon officially assigned, authority to store/carry, special training, periodic professional fitness check, right granted by leader's order. NFR: employee profile must hold the order reference ('rahbar buyrug‘i'), training and fitness-check dates with expiry; expired fitness check → authorization denied with that reason.

findings.topic: Document status: not a TZ; norms agreed with IIV, certifier, customer
findings.detail: 'Mazkur hujjat texnik topshiriq emas… Yakuniy me’yoriy talablar IIVning vakolatli bo‘linmasi, sertifikatlash organi va buyurtmachi bilan kelishiladi.' NFR: the admin panel prototype must be configurable (retention, roles, factors, thresholds) rather than hard-coding assumptions that the TZ negotiation may change.

findings.topic: Legal sources to cite in the TZ
findings.detail: O'RQ-550 'Qurol to‘g‘risida' (lex.uz/docs/4445290); Cabinet of Ministers decree No. 455 of 2020-07-28 (lex.uz/docs/4920582); decree No. 810 of 2020-12-26 (lex.uz/docs/5190180); Law 'Ichki ishlar organlari to‘g‘risida' (lex.uz/docs/3027845). The sources do not cite the personal-data law; biometric handling will need it (see gaps).

findings.topic: Target customer and unit types (organizational hierarchy)
findings.detail: First customer: IIV and its territorial/functional units: tuman/shahar IIB; patrul-post xizmati; qo‘riqlash va tezkor bo‘linmalar; maxsus operatsion bo‘linmalar; navbatchilik qismlari; o‘quv markazlari. Later: Milliy gvardiya, bojxona, harbiy qismlar, other licensed organizations. NFR: multi-organization tenancy with an org tree; unit type is an attribute used in reports.

EN 14450:2017+A1:2023 (secure storage units, S1/S2 burglary resistance), EN 1143-1 (safes), EN 1300 (high-security locks), IEC 60529 (IP rating of electronics enclosure), EN 356 and EN 12600 (glass — now moot with the metal door). NFR (software side): the lock class and IP rating are cabinet-model attributes stored in the inventory so certification status is visible per cabinet model.

findings.topic: Glass door certification risk and metal-door decision
findings.detail: 'Qonunda “seyf yoki metall shkaf” talabi bor. To‘liq oynali tashqi eshik sertifikatlash va IIV bilan kelishishda muammo tug‘dirishi mumkin. Eng xavfsiz variant — metall tashqi eshik va ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko‘rsatish.' 02 §6/03 confirm a glass door removes the cabinet from GOST R 55148-2012 (= EN 14450) S1–S2 and from the national 'metall shkaf' requirement. User chose metal. NFR: since the interior is no longer visible, the admin panel/terminal must show interior state (sensor-derived item presence, optional interior camera) — 'ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko‘rsatish'.

findings.topic: Certification notes from the 3D concept work
findings.detail: 'Sertifikatlash: … qulf drayveri shkaf ichida; hujjatlarda derating yozilishi shart' — lock driver inside the cabinet; any derating (e.g. 'tekshiruv shkafi' documentation) must be written into the documents. 02 §10 pre-prototype list: 'qulf, datchik va signal tizimi sxemasi; ankerlash loyihasi; me’yoriy derating hujjati'. NFR: the server-side lock command path must be documented as part of the certification dossier (which component can energize the lock, under what authenticated condition).

Row 'Sinov': 'IIV ichki me’yorlari, sertifikatlash sinfi va qabul sinovlari' (IIV internal norms, certification class, acceptance tests). TZ section 'sinov, qabul qilish va sertifikatlash'. NFR: build an acceptance-test log/report export into the admin panel (test mode events flagged as test, excluded from statistics).

'sim-plomba ko‘zlari… plomba qulf emas' — wire-seal eyes on the free-edge rail; for the ammo can 'plomba qulf emas'. NFR (optional): inventory item can carry a seal number; seal replacement is a manual, attributed event.

1 maqsad, qo‘llanish sohasi va atamalar; 2 funksional va foydalanuvchi talablari; 3 mexanik konstruksiya va materiallar; 4 qulf, datchik, identifikatsiya va elektr ta’minoti; 5 dasturiy ta’minot, rollar, jurnal va dashboard; 6 lokal tarmoq, server va API integratsiyasi; 7 axborot xavfsizligi va biometrik ma’lumotlarni himoya qilish; 8 favqulodda holatlar va fail-safe/fail-secure siyosati; 9 sinov, qabul qilish va sertifikatlash; 10 ishlab chiqarish, o‘rnatish, kafolat va servis. The admin panel maps to sections 5, 6, 7, 8.

findings.topic: Customer inputs required before the TZ (7 groups)
findings.detail: Jihozlar: exact AK/PM models, magazines, ammo, body camera, protective gear; Vakolat: who opens, who confirms, how many responsible persons in emergency access; Integratsiya: employee DB, service card, duty roster, video surveillance; Saqlash: retention of journal, biometrics, video and archive requirement; Muhit: armory size, power, network, temperature, humidity, installation conditions; Sinov: IIV norms, certification class, acceptance tests; Ko‘lam: pilot unit, cabinet count, shifts, user count. These are questions for IIV, not for the user.

'IIVdan uchta ko‘rsatkich olinadi: (1) qurol biriktirilgan xodimlar soni; (2) qurol saqlanadigan bo‘linmalar soni; (3) har bir bo‘linmadagi qurolli smena xodimlari soni.' NFR: the admin panel's org/unit model should be able to report these three numbers directly once populated.
findings.source: 01 §3.6 box 'ANIQ EHTIYOJ UCHUN KERAK BO‘LGAN MA’LUMOT'

findings.detail: Oddiy xodim (uses only own cabinet and permitted items); Qurolxona mas’uli (receives/issues weapons, registers inventory, assigns and blocks cabinets); Navbatchi yoki komandir (confirms service permission, temporary authority, emergency opening); Administrator (users/system/electronics settings, no weapon authority); Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat (views journal, statistics, delays, emergency openings, inventory differences). 06's three roles (Сотрудник/Оператор/Администратор) are a coarser version.

jami va mavjud qurollar; ayni paytda berilgan qurollar; vaqtida qaytarilmagan qurollar; nosoz yoki bloklangan shkaflar; sutkalik olish-qaytarishlar; rad etilgan kirish urinishlari; favqulodda ochilishlar; inventarizatsiyadagi farqlar; hudud va bo‘linmalar bo‘yicha holat. NFR: these nine are the dashboard's mandatory widgets; each must be filterable by org scope.

Xodim: F.I.Sh., tabel raqami, bo‘linma, xizmat holati; Shkaf: raqami, manzili, texnik holati; Qurol: turi, modeli, seriya raqami, RFID; O‘q-dori: kalibr, partiya, miqdor; Olish/qaytarish: sana, vaqt, davomiylik; Kirish usuli: karta, PIN, biometrika, favqulodda; Rad etilgan kirish: kim, qachon, sababi, urinishlar soni; Kechikish; Inventar: mavjud, yo‘q, nosoz, xizmatda; Signal: urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi, quvvat uzilishi. NFR: this is the minimum schema for the admin panel's entities and event payloads.

Shelves and holders are removable/height-adjustable so 'turli lavozim va komplektatsiyadagi xodimlar uchun bitta bazaviy korpusdan foydalanish' — one base body serves different positions/kits; zones: 0–1150 AK-74 + bag, 1150–1450 ammo/body armour, 1450–1700 PM/magazines/cuffs, 1700–1950 helmet/gas mask, 1950–2000 cables/LED/sensors. NFR: cabinet model has a configurable compartment list (each with its own lock/sensor IDs) so the server can reflect different kits.

'Qaytarishda aynan biriktirilgan jihozlar joyiga qo‘yilgani tekshiriladi' (on return, exactly the bound items are verified in place); international: 'Qaytarishda aynan tegishli qurol tekshiriladi'. NFR: return event compares RFID/sensor set against the profile's bound items; mismatch → 'inventarizatsiyadagi farq' record + alert to responsible person.

3.5″ display shows 'holat, ko‘rsatmalar (“chapga qadam qo‘ying, eshikni oching”), xodim ID'. NFR: terminal UI strings are Uzbek (user default) and served/updated from the server; employee is shown by ID, not full name, on the public display (privacy default).

findings.topic: Mechanical interlocks visible to the server
findings.detail: Viewer logic: rifle can only be removed with the door ≥ 90° open; the door cannot close while the rifle is out ('Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi'); the door swings away from the module so the reader is never blocked. NFR: server should treat 'door closed while item absent' as a legitimate state only after an issue event; otherwise raise inconsistency.

findings.topic: NFR — availability of the cabinet↔server link
findings.detail: Derived: normal issue/return must complete with the organization server unreachable (01 concept 'Offline ishlash', §4.5, §4.7 event cache); only administrative changes (new assignments, revocations) require the server. Target: armory node authorizes locally from a permission cache; cache freshness and revocation propagation on reconnect are logged.

Derived from immutable/protected journal (01 §4.5, §4.4, §2.6) and 06 'неизменяемый журнал': each event has cabinet ID, controller sequence number, local timestamp, terminal ID, actor, factors used, lock IDs affected, sensor snapshot, and a hash of the previous event from the same cabinet; server verifies chain continuity and flags gaps as 'possible tampering/loss'.

Derived from 03 'modul faqat autentifikatsiyalangan (shifrlangan) signal yuboradi' and 02 §5.4: unlock commands to the cabinet controller are signed/encrypted with a per-cabinet key provisioned at commissioning; commands include nonce + expiry; controller rejects replays; the terminal/armory node cannot forge a command for a cabinet it is not paired with.

findings.topic: NFR — alarm latency and path redundancy
findings.detail: Derived from 03 detection chain (sensor → module → 'qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE)') and 01 §3.4 signal list: tamper/impact/door-left-open/power-loss alarms are delivered to the admin panel and guard post within seconds over LAN, with LTE fallback; alarms are also stored locally so a cut link cannot hide them.

Derived from 01 §3.6 and §5 TZ section 7: enrolment and matching happen on the terminal/armory node; templates are encrypted; the admin panel never displays or exports raw templates; deletion on employee departure is an audited administrative action; biometric data never leaves Uzbek territory.

findings.topic: NFR — scoped access and read-only oversight
findings.detail: Derived from 01 §2.4 (Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat) and §4.7 ('vakolat doirasida'): inspectors and leadership get read-only access limited to their org scope; no role except the administrator can change configuration, and the administrator cannot approve weapon issue (separation of duties).

Derived from 01 §3.6 and §4.6: the admin panel ships as an offline-installable package (no external CDN/fonts/JS at runtime), runs on the armory Raspberry Pi (SQLite) and on an organization server (PostgreSQL), and is administered from within the IIV network.

Derived from 01 §3.1/§3.2/§3.6: pilot 50 cabinets and ≤200 events/day; regional pilot 500 cabinets, ~2 000 events/day; republic 5 000+ cabinets, 20 000 events/day, 7.3 M events/year retained long-term; dashboards must aggregate over multi-year history without full scans (pre-aggregated daily counters).

Derived from 03 'Ichki joy' (DC-UPS, LiFePO4 ≈5 h), 01 §4.7 (armory UPS) and 01 §3.4 ('quvvat uzilishi'): telemetry includes mains present, on-battery, battery voltage/estimated runtime; a cabinet on battery for longer than a configurable threshold escalates the alarm; fail-secure means loss of power never unlocks (06).

Derived from 03 'Xizmat kirishi' (front service door and upper hatch with tamper sensors, all service from the front): the admin panel needs a maintenance mode per cabinet/terminal that records the technician, suppresses hatch-tamper alarms for a bounded window, and blocks weapon issue while the cabinet is 'xizmatda' (01 §3.4 inventory state).

contradictions.issue: Per-cabinet full-height electronics module (SBC, face-recognition processor, 24 V PSU, DC-UPS, LiFePO4 20 Ah, LTE router in every cabinet) vs. shared Face ID terminal + local controller + comms module per 10–20 cabinets with only a cheap controller, lock, ID and sensors in each cabinet.
contradictions.sources: 02 §5.4 and 03 <aside> items 'Modul korpusi', 'Ichki joy', 'Xizmat kirishi' vs. 01 §3.3 'Joylashuv va elektronika iqtisodi' and 01 §4.7 'Tavsiya etiladigan arxitektura'
contradictions.resolution: 01 is the source of truth: the 03 module is the lab-prototype (1–2 unit) configuration; from the 'sinov' stage (10–20 cabinets) the shared-terminal architecture applies. The admin panel data model must have a Terminal entity with 1:N cabinets and must not assume a per-cabinet LTE router or per-cabinet face processor.

contradictions.issue: Face as the primary authentication factor ('yuz — asosiy omil') vs. primary = service card + fingerprint or PIN, Face ID only additional, Face-ID-only explicitly not recommended (masks, helmets, lighting, camera failure).
contradictions.sources: 03 <aside> item 'Face ID moduli'; 03 JS auth flow face→finger vs. 01 §4.2 box 'TAVSIYA ETILADIGAN AUTENTIFIKATSIYA'
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins: card (or Face ID) identifies, fingerprint or PIN verifies, then duty/position/permission check (01 §2.5). The viewer's idle/face/finger/ok/open/lock states are extended with card, PIN, check, denied and emergency states.

contradictions.issue: Glazed door with glass-break sensor + accelerometer detection chain and 'tekshiruv shkafi' derating vs. law's 'seyf yoki metall shkaf' requirement and the recommendation for a metal outer door with interior state shown on camera/screen.
contradictions.sources: 02 §5.5/§6 and 03 <aside> 'Oynali eshik' vs. 01 §1.5 box 'OYNALI ESHIK BO‘YICHA XAVF'; user decision 2026-09-09 (metal door)
contradictions.resolution: Metal door per 01 and the user's decision. Glass-break sensor is dropped; impact and tamper sensors (01 §1.4) and the sensor→module→guard-post alarm chain remain. Because the interior is no longer visible, the terminal/admin panel must present interior state (sensor-derived presence, optional interior camera).

contradictions.issue: UPS placement: DC-UPS + battery inside each cabinet's module vs. UPS at the armory local-controller level.
contradictions.resolution: Not a hard conflict — 01 §1.4 also requires 'Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat' at the cabinet. Layered design: armory UPS for gateway/terminal/local server, small DC-UPS per cabinet for lock controller and sensors. Telemetry distinguishes the two.

contradictions.issue: Role model: three roles (Сотрудник / Оператор / Администратор) vs. five roles (Oddiy xodim / Qurolxona mas’uli / Navbatchi yoki komandir / Administrator / Tekshiruvchi-rahbariyat).
contradictions.resolution: Use 01's five roles. 06's Оператор is split into Qurolxona mas’uli and Navbatchi/komandir; 06's 'аудит системных правок' is kept as an additional requirement (configuration-change audit log).

contradictions.issue: Multi-cell shared locker ('персональная ячейка' — personal cell in a bank of cells) vs. one full-height individual cabinet per employee.
contradictions.sources: 06 infographic illustration and 'Доступ только к своей ячейке' vs. 01 concept 'Bir xodim — bir shkaf' and 01 §4.6
contradictions.resolution: 01: one cabinet per employee. 06's 'cell' language maps to compartments/locks inside one cabinet (door, AK barrel lock, PM box, ammo strap, magazine bay per 03), which is why per-compartment permissions are still needed.

contradictions.issue: Cabinet dimensions 400 × 646 × 2056 mm (module width 600) vs. 2000 × 400 × 600 mm (2000 × 600 × 600 with module).
contradictions.resolution: 01's 2000 × 400 × 600 is the documented gabarit; 03 remains the visual model. Only affects cabinet-model attributes in the admin panel (store nominal dimensions from 01).

gaps: Intra-armory bus and LAN technology between cabinet controller, shared terminal and armory node (RS-485 / CAN / Ethernet / PoE) is not named in any source; only 'umumiy aloqa/boshqaruv moduli', 'tarmoq shlyuzi' and an LTE router appear. Engineer default: RS-485 (or Ethernet) cabinet→armory, Ethernet armory→server, LTE as WAN fallback — no question to the user needed.

Transport-security specifics (TLS/mTLS, key provisioning at commissioning, per-device certificates, event signing/hash chain) are not specified — sources only say 'autentifikatsiyalangan (shifrlangan) signal' and 'o‘chirib bo‘lmaydigan jurnal'. Engineer default: mTLS + per-cabinet key + hash-chained events.
Retention periods for event journal, biometric templates and video are explicitly deferred to the customer (01 §5.1 'Saqlash'); implement as configurable settings, ask IIV, not the user.
Number of responsible persons for emergency opening ('nechta mas’ul shaxs qatnashadi') is a customer input (01 §5.1 'Vakolat'); default: configurable 1 or 2 approvers, two-person rule available.

Identity of the existing HR, service-card, duty-roster and video-surveillance systems and their APIs/card technology is a customer input (01 §5.1 'Integratsiya'); build adapters behind internal interfaces, prototype with manual data entry.

Uzbek personal-data / biometric-data legislation is not cited in 01 (only 'ma’lumotlar O‘zbekiston hududida' and 'biometrik shablon himoyalangan shaklda'); the TZ's information-security section must reference the applicable personal-data law and any state-sector information-security certification/crypto requirements — legal input, not answerable from the sources.

Time synchronization source for audit timestamps (NTP inside IIV network vs. GPS/LTE time) and behaviour when the armory node's clock drifts offline are not covered; default: armory node is the NTP authority for cabinets, server reconciles with drift flag.

Policy for permissions revoked centrally while the armory is offline (cache TTL, grace period, whether a stale permission may still open) is not covered; default: cached permissions valid until a configurable TTL, revocations applied immediately on reconnect and logged.
Failed-attempt lockout threshold and PIN policy (length, storage) are not given — 01 §3.4 only records 'urinishlar soni'; engineer default: configurable threshold with alert to responsible person.
Unlock-without-open timeout (relock if the door is not opened after authorization) is not specified in 01/02/03; default: short configurable timeout, event logged.
Server backup/DR (RPO/RTO), high availability of the organization server and archival export format for the long-term journal are not covered by any source.
