Whether the interior camera recommended by 01 §1.5 ('ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko‘rsatish') is part of the prototype scope, and where its images are stored, is not decided; treat as optional module.

Alarm forwarding interface to the existing armory security-fire alarm / guard post (dry contact, network message) is not specified; 03 only says 'qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE)'; default: relay output on armory node + panel notification.

findings.detail: Main door has a door-closed sensor; the lock engages automatically when the door closes. 03 aside 'O'quvchi': "qulflash eshik yopilganda avtomatik (eshik sensori)"; JS comment in animateDoors(): 'the lock is driven by the door-closed sensor, not by a second press'; state open->lock fires when all doors reach 0 deg. 01 §1.4 requires "Eshik holati ... datchiklari" and 01 §3.4 lists "eshik ochiq qolishi" as an alarm, so the device must also report door-open duration (door_open_timeout).

findings.topic: Door angle / >=90 deg condition for rifle removal
findings.detail: Rifle may only be removed with the door held at >=90 deg (door stop 100 deg; below 86 deg the door sweeps the rifle path). JS toggleDrawer(): if door angle <90 shows tip "Avval eshikni 90° dan ortiq oching". Physically this means either a door-angle sensor or a simple open/closed switch plus the barrel-clamp solenoid only releasing when door is confirmed open. Default: door-open switch + clamp release gated on door_open=true.

findings.topic: Tamper sensors on module service hatches
findings.detail: "lyuklarda tamper-datchiklar, buzishga chidamli ilmoqlar; eshikning oshiq-moshiq tomonida buzishga qarshi shtiftlar" — tamper switches on the front service door (155×1150 mm, z 150…1300) and the upper LTE hatch (155×200 mm, z 1650…1850); anti-pry pins on the hinge side of the main door. Telemetry: tamper_service_door, tamper_upper_hatch.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Xavfsizlik' (module row), 'Xizmat kirishi'; JS SERVICE_DOOR / UPPER_HATCH boxes

findings.detail: With the glazed door the security concept is DETECTION: "shisha sinishi datchigi + 3 o'qli akselerometr → elektronika moduli → qorovul posti (signal, jurnal, LTE)". Under 01 (metal door) the glass-break sensor is dropped, but the 3-axis accelerometer stays as the "urilish va buzishga urinish" sensor required by 01 §1.4 and the "Urilish, buzish" alarm of 01 §3.4. Telemetry: impact_detected (g-level, axis), tamper_attempt.

findings.topic: AK-74 stock pressure sensor ("qo'ndoq ostidagi bosim datchigi")
findings.detail: 01 §4.3 'Mexanik/holat datchigi': for the AK-74 a pressure sensor under the butt, a state sensor in the barrel clamp and RFID work together; "Kritik holat kamida ikki turdagi signal bilan tasdiqlanadi" (a critical state must be confirmed by at least two sensor types). 03 only models the rubber butt cradle (Shore A 60–70 block z 180…215, pocket 135×55×15 mm, 5° floor) — the pressure sensor sits inside/under this cradle. Telemetry: ak_present (2-of-3 vote: pressure, clamp, RFID).
findings.source: 01 §4.3 'Mexanik/holat datchigi'; 03 aside 'Beshik va qisqich'; JS addCab 'Qo'ndoq beshigi'

findings.topic: Barrel clamp state sensor ("stvol qisqichidagi holat datchigi")
findings.detail: State sensor in the U-slot barrel clamp (22×30 mm polyurethane-lined bracket z 965…995, 47 mm above gas block, 83 mm below front-sight base). Reports barrel_in_clamp and clamp_lock_engaged (solenoid plate y −118…−108, z 970…990, 10 mm hard bolt, gap <=1 mm).
findings.source: 01 §4.3; 03 aside 'Beshik va qisqich'; JS addCab 'Stvol qisqichi' / 'Stvol qulfi'

findings.topic: Weight sensors for magazine and ammunition compartments ("vazn datchigi")
findings.detail: 01 §4.3 'Vazn datchigi': weight sensor in the magazine and ammo compartments detects slot occupancy and total-weight change; it does NOT legally prove round count but gives an extra inventory signal. Applies to the 4-slot AK magazine rack (30 mm pitch, on the 1553 shelf) and the sealed steel ammo box 240×200×130 on the 1293 shelf. Telemetry: mag_rack_weight_g, ammo_box_weight_g, plus derived mag_slots_occupied (0–4).
findings.source: 01 §4.3, §4.5; 03 aside 'Jihozlar (1 askar)'; JS addCab 'AK magazin uyasi', 'O'q-dori qutisi'

findings.detail: 01 §2.3: AK-74 and PM bound by serial number + RFID identifier; magazines by inventory number and count; helmet/armor by inventory number; body camera by device serial. 01 §4.3 'RFID': every weapon, magazine and important item linked to serial/inventory number via RFID for automatic take/return and fast inventory. 03 models no RFID antenna — placement is a design task (default: antenna at AK slot, at PM box, at mag rack, and one wide-field antenna for helmet/armor/bag zone). Telemetry: rfid_scan {tag_id, slot, present}.

01 §1.4 "Elektr uzilganda zaxira quvvat"; 01 §3.4 alarm "quvvat uzilishi". 03 module: 24 V/150 W PSU + DIN DC-UPS + 12.8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 (≈5 h). Telemetry: mains_ok, on_battery, battery_soc_pct, battery_voltage, ups_fault.

"ombor 5 °C dan sovisa 30–50 W termostatli isitgich"; heat dissipation 30–60 W through steel walls (≈5 K rise), no forced cooling. Implies a temperature probe in the module. Telemetry: module_temp_c, heater_on.

01 §1.4: "mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi" — use of the emergency mechanical key must be separately logged, therefore the lock needs a key-cylinder switch. 03 shows only a motorised latch/lock box ("motorli ilgak/qulf qutisi") without a mechanical override; 01 wins. Telemetry: mechanical_key_used (event, timestamp).

findings.topic: Rifle-out interlock ("Avtomat tashqarida turganda eshik yopilmaydi")
findings.detail: 03 'Olish harakati': the door cannot close while the rifle is out; JS requestDoors() sets pendingDoor and retracts drawers first with tip "Avval avtomatlar joyiga qo'yiladi…". In hardware this is a soft interlock: door_closed with ak_present=false must raise an event (weapon issued) rather than block the door mechanically. Derived event: weapon_issued when door closes with ak_present=false (or pm_present=false).

Every solenoid lock (barrel clamp plate, PM box lock, ammo strap solenoid, magazine-rack lid) needs a bolt/position feedback so the twin can show locked/unlocked truthfully; 03 specifies the actuators, not the feedback. 01 §1.4 "Qurol va o'q-dori holati mustaqil nazorat qilinadi" requires weapon and ammo state to be monitored independently.

findings.topic: Main door lock — motorised latch/lock box, auto-lock on close, manual door
findings.detail: "motorli ilgak/qulf qutisi" inside the door at x −317…−254, y 205…227, z 980…1120 (in the 230 mm solid band between windows); bolt ("rigel") passes through a cut in liner 7 into the 3 mm L-strike strip (x −336.4…−321, full height). Door is opened BY HAND — "eshik qo'lda ochiladi, elektr yuritma yo'q" / "O'ng eshikka elektr yuritma qo'yilmasin". Auto-lock on door close via door sensor. Hinges on the left (axis x 28.55, y 219.77; 4 knuckles z 2062.3/1459.3/856.3/252.3), opens left away from the module, 100° rubber buffer + hydraulic closer. Command: unlock_door (pulse); state: door_locked.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Oynali eshik', 'Eshik tirgagi', note under spec list; META.hinges; 02 §5.4, §5.5

findings.topic: Lock driver placement — inside protected volume; module sends only authenticated signal
findings.detail: "qulf yuritmasi (relelar) va qulf quvvat chiqishi shkafning himoyalangan hajmi ichida qoladi — modul faqat autentifikatsiyalangan (shifrlangan) signal yuboradi, shuning uchun modulni ochib qulfni tutashtirib bo'lmaydi". Relays with TVS protection. Architecture consequence: the per-cabinet ESP32 controller and relays live INSIDE the cabinet; the terminal/module only sends signed unlock commands. Same rule must apply to server->cabinet commands (signed, replay-protected).

findings.topic: Barrel clamp solenoid lock ("Stvol qulfi — solenoidli planka, Face ID orqali ochiladi")
findings.detail: Solenoid lock plate in front of the U-clamp, y −118…−108, z 970…990, 10 mm hardened bolt, plate recessed into clamp face (gap <=1 mm), under a slotted 1.5 mm steel C-hood (y −170…−90, z 955…1005, 26 mm slot x −286…−260), Torx-pin fasteners. Released only on authorised 'avtomat' permission. Command: unlock_ak_clamp; state: ak_clamp_locked.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Beshik va qisqich', 'Oynali eshik' (Ichki himoya); JS addCab 'Stvol qulfi', hoodRole

findings.topic: PM box electronic lock — separate permission
findings.detail: Makarov PM (161×127×30) + 2 magazines in a separate electronically locked box 200×160×60 on the 1553 shelf, bolted from inside (fasteners under lid), body >=2 mm, hidden hinge axis. "PM qutisi va stvol qulfi — ikkita alohida ruxsat (avtomat / to'pponcha)" — rifle and pistol are two separate authorisations. Command: unlock_pm_box; state: pm_box_locked, pm_present.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Jihozlar (1 askar)', 'Beshik va qisqich', 'Xavfsizlik'; JS addCab 'PM to'pponcha qutisi'; 02 §5.4

findings.topic: Ammo box lock strap solenoid (tied to PM permission)
findings.detail: "O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari 3 × 30 mm — −x oyoqda sharnir, +x oyoqda solenoid (PM qutisi ruxsati), qutiga 2 mm rezina" — a 3×30 steel strap over the sealed ammo box 240×200×130 on the 1293 shelf (waist height), hinged on −x leg, solenoid on +x leg; released with the PM-box permission; "plomba qulf emas". Command: unlock_ammo_strap; state: ammo_strap_locked.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Oynali eshik' (Ichki himoya); JS addCab 'O'q-dori qutisi qulf kamari'

findings.detail: "AK magazin uyasi — 4 joy, 30 mm qadam, qulflanadigan qopqoq"; 4 magazines 5.45×39 (30 rounds) stored empty. Lock actuator type unspecified in 03 (default: same solenoid class as ammo strap, released together with 'avtomat' permission). Command: unlock_mag_rack; state: mag_rack_locked, mag_slots_occupied.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Jihozlar (1 askar)', 'Xavfsizlik'; JS addCab 'AK magazin uyasi', magazine loop

findings.topic: Interior LED strips (2 × 12 V) switched by reader / door sensor
findings.detail: Two 12 V LED strips: top front edge z 2140 and under the 1293 shelf z 1281 (housings y <=172), "Face ID / eshik datchigi orqali yonadi". Original purpose: light the kit through the glass. With 01's metal door they remain useful for an interior camera / open-door inspection. Command: set_interior_light; state: interior_light_on.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Oynali eshik' (bo'lim ichida ... LED korpuslari y ≤ 172); JS addCab LED entries; 02 §5.5 'Yoritish'

findings.topic: Status LED bar 60×3 mm — four colours
findings.detail: "60 × 3 mm chiziq: ko'k — kutish, sariq — barmoq, yashil — ruxsat, qizil — qulf". JS hex values: blue 0x2f9bff (idle/face, pulsing during face), yellow 0xffb547 (finger, pulsing), green 0x3ddc84 (ok 1.6 / open 1.2), red 0xff5252 (lock 1.4). The fingerprint LED ring (ringMat) mirrors the same colour via setLeds(). Missing in 03 but required by 01 §3.4: a distinct DENIED indication (default: red blink) and a BLOCKED/ALARM indication.

Display at ≈1390 mm from floor shows "holat, ko'rsatmalar ('chapga qadam qo'ying, eshikni oching'), xodim ID". JS canvas 296×224 px: header bar with 'SMART SHKAF' left and 'QULF'/'OCHIQ' right; icon (face / fingerprint arcs / check / padlock); two text lines; progress bar during face/finger. Command: display_message (for server-pushed notices, e.g. late return, blocked).
Only when the store falls below 5 °C. Command/config: heater_setpoint_c; state: heater_on.

findings.topic: Electronics module envelope (03 concept — superseded by 01 for scale)
findings.detail: 200 × 623 × 2056 mm (x −559.4…−359.4, y −389…234, z 104…2160), 3 mm steel, own plinth, flush on the new right wall, front 3 mm proud of the door skin, welded side panel — all service from the front. Interior ≈0.23 m³ (internal width ≈194 mm; required ≈0.04 m³). Mass ≈110–150 kg. 01 §1.1 keeps a 150–200 mm module in the accepted gabarit (2000×600×600 with module) but 01 §3.3/§4.7 say a full-height module per cabinet raises cost; the optimum is one shared terminal per 10–20 cabinets.

On a mounting plate with 2 × 550 mm DIN rails: "kontroller (SBC, o'quvchi orqasida z ≈ 1400) va yuz tanish protsessori". 02 §5.4: "Kontroller/SBC + yuz tanish protsessori". 01 §4.7 maps this to: per cabinet an ESP32/STM32-class controller; per 10–20 cabinets one Face ID terminal with screen and shared communication/control module; per armory a local controller (user default: Raspberry Pi) with UPS, event cache and network gateway.

findings.topic: Power: 24 V/150 W PSU, DIN DC-UPS, LiFePO4 battery
findings.detail: "24 V/150 W quvvat bloki, DIN DC-UPS ... akkumulyator pastda tortmada — 12,8 V 20 Ah LiFePO4 (181 × 77 × 167, ≈5 soat) yoki 2 × 12 V 9 Ah; eng kichik o'lchami ≤ 130 mm". 02 §5.4 same. Under 01 §4.7 the armory-level UPS covers the shared terminal and local controller; each cabinet still needs enough backup for lock, sensors and event cache (01 §1.4).

findings.topic: Lock-drive relays with TVS, door sensors, terminals
findings.detail: "qulf yuritmasi relelari (TVS himoyasi bilan), eshik sensorlari, klemmalar" on the DIN rails — but per the 'Xavfsizlik' row the lock drive and lock power output must stay inside the cabinet's protected volume.

LTE router in the upper hatch 155×200 mm (z 1650…1850); "LTE uchun modul ustida SMA o'tkazgichli tashqi antenna (po'lat korpus ichida signal yo'q)". JS box 'Tashqi LTE antenna (SMA o'tkazgich modul ustida)' at z 2160…2250. Under 01 §4.7 the LTE/network gateway belongs to the armory level ("tarmoq shlyuzi"), not to each cabinet; 01 §4.6 stresses IIV local server and offline-first. Telemetry (armory gateway): lte_rssi, wan_up, last_sync.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Xizmat kirishi', 'Aloqa va EMC'; JS UPPER_HATCH, antenna box; 01 §4.6, §4.7

findings.topic: Service access: front service door + upper hatch, both keyed and sealed
findings.detail: Front service door 155 × 1150 mm (z 150…1300, threshold 46 mm) with key and gasket — battery tray + swing-out DIN frame; upper hatch 155 × 200 mm — LTE router. JS boxes: 'Xizmat eshigi qulfi', 'Yuqori lyuk qulfi'. Each hatch carries a tamper sensor (see A).
findings.source: 03 aside 'Xizmat kirishi'; JS SERVICE_DOOR / UPPER_HATCH + lock boxes

findings.topic: Enclosure environment: IP54, membrane valve, thermal budget
findings.detail: "korpus germetik IP54: zichlagichli lyuklar, ochiq shamollatish panjarasi yo'q, IP54 membranali bosim klapani; 30–60 W issiqlik tarqalishi po'lat devorlar orqali (≈ 5 K isish) — majburiy sovutish kerak emas". 01 §1.5 references IEC 60529 for the electronics IP rating.
findings.source: 03 aside 'Muhit'; JS box 'IP54 membranali bosim klapani'; 01 §1.5

findings.detail: "o'quvchi shlanglari ekranlangan, EMC o'tkazgichda yerga ulangan, qulf quvvat kabellaridan ≥ 50 mm ajratilgan, signal va quvvat uchun alohida o'tkazgichlar"; cables pass through the shared wall into the cabinet.

Module: 200 mm base → tipping risk (5.6°) → first 2–4 × M10 floor anchors, then 4–6 × M8 wall bolts (z ≈400/1100/1800) through the new right wall with weld nuts; installation needs ≥500 mm free on the right, ≥200 mm in service. Cabinet: 2 × M12 floor anchors mandatory, M8 wall (y ≈192). 01 §1.4: floor ≥2 × M12, wall M8–M10 — consistent.

"120 × 260 × 14 mm maxsus modul, old plitaga tekis o'rnatilgan (x −519…−399, z 1340…1600), eshik chetidan 65 mm o'ngda; hech bir element plitadan 12 mm dan ortiq chiqmaydi"; centre at z 1470 (JS readerMount at (−459.4, 220, 1470)); on the soldier's right hand when facing the door; open door does not shade the reader.

"IR kamera Ø10, RGB kamera Ø8, IR yoritgich Ø6 — 100 × 44 mm oyna, 11° yuqoriga qiya bezelda (bo'yi 1,90 m askar 0,5 m masofada ham kadrda), pol sathidan 1466 mm; yuz — asosiy omil". JS faceGroup tilted −11°, three lenses at x −30/0/+30 radii 5/4/3. NOTE: 'yuz — asosiy omil' conflicts with 01 §4.2 (see section I).

"sig'imli sensor Ø24 mm, LED halqa, 35° yuqoriga qaragan beshikda, pol sathidan ≈1290 mm (bilak 20–35° qiya, barmoq yostiqchasi bilan tegadi); qo'lqopda ishlamaydi — karta/PIN zaxira usuli ko'zda tutilsin". JS fpGroup tilted −35°, recessed 9 mm.

findings.topic: Service card (RFID) + PIN — required by 01, absent from 03 reader
findings.detail: 01 §2.3 access right = "Xizmat kartasi + biometrika/PIN + xizmat holati"; 01 §4.2 recommended authentication: "Asosiy: xizmat kartasi + barmoq izi yoki PIN. Qo'shimcha: Face ID. Favqulodda: vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN + mexanik kalit." 03's reader has no card antenna and no PIN keypad (display is 3.5" and not stated as touch). Design consequence: add RFID card reader and PIN entry (keypad or touch display) to the reader/terminal; card technology must match the existing IIV service card (01 §5.1 'Integratsiya').

01 §4.2 lists "yuqori xavfli operatsiyada ikki xodim tasdig'i"; 01 §2.6 emergency mass opening by authorised duty officer / armory keeper / commander: "vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN, zarur holatda ikki mas'ul shaxs tasdig'i", each such opening written to a non-erasable separate journal. The terminal/reader must support a second-person auth step and the server must support remote second approval.

findings.topic: State machine in 03 JS: idle → face → finger → ok → open → lock → idle
findings.detail: auth.state values: 'idle', 'face', 'finger', 'ok', 'open', 'lock'. Timings (AF=1): face 1300 ms, finger 1400 ms, ok 700 ms then doors→100° and state 'open'; lock 1500 ms then 'idle'. Transition open→lock is triggered by the door-closed condition. Button labels: 'Kirish' (idle), '…' (busy), 'Yopish va qulflash' (open).

findings.topic: Display texts per state (Uzbek, reuse verbatim)
findings.detail: idle: "Yuzingizni kameraga" / "qarating"; face: "Yuz tanilmoqda…" / "NN %"; finger: "Barmoq izini" / "beshikka qo'ying"; ok: "Ruxsat · Xodim #01" / "Chapga qadam qo'ying, eshikni oching"; open: "Eshiklar ochiq" / "Yopilganda avtomatik qulflanadi"; lock: "Qulflandi" / "". Header right corner: 'OCHIQ' when open else 'QULF'. Header left: 'SMART SHKAF'.

"Avval avtomatlar joyiga qo'yiladi…" (door close requested while rifle out) and "Avval eshikni 90° dan ortiq oching" (rifle grab attempted with door <90°). Reusable as device display messages: return-weapon-first prompt and open-door-fully prompt.
findings.source: 03 JS showTip() calls in doorSlider input, requestDoors(), toggleDrawer()

findings.topic: States missing from 03 that 01/06 require (to be added to firmware + twin)
findings.detail: 01 §3.4 'Rad etilgan kirish' (who, when, reason, attempt count) → DENIED state; 01 §2.4 armory keeper "shkafni ... bloklaydi" → BLOCKED state; 01 §3.4 'Signal' (impact, tamper, door left open, power loss) → ALARM state; 01 §2.6 → EMERGENCY_OPEN state; 01 'Offline ishlash' → OFFLINE (local permissions) state; 06 modes → SBOR / TREVOGA (mass issue) mode; 01 §4.4 → RETURN_EXPECTED / LATE state; 01 §4.4 "Ko'rik yoki ta'mirdan o'tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi" → ITEM_HOLD (issue blocked per item).
Because rifle and pistol are separate authorisations (03) the ok/open screen should state which sub-locks were released (e.g. 'Avtomat', 'To'pponcha', both). 03 shows only a generic 'Ruxsat'.

01 §2.3: cabinet number, officer 'tabel raqami' and equipment identifiers are bound in one electronic profile; 01 §3.4 'Shkaf': number, address, technical state. Every telemetry record: cabinet_id, armory_id, terminal_id (shared terminal per 01 §4.7), device_time (+ server-received time), sequence number for offline replay, firmware_version.

auth_started {terminal_id}; factor results: card_read {card_uid}, face_result {ok/fail, score}, finger_result {ok/fail}, pin_result {ok/fail}; access_granted {officer_id, method: karta|PIN|biometrika|favqulodda, permissions: [avtomat, to'pponcha]}; access_denied {officer_id?, reason: not_assigned|no_duty|blocked|biometric_fail|pin_fail|schedule, attempt_no}. 01 §3.4 'Kirish usuli' and 'Rad etilgan kirish' define the required fields.

door_unlocked, door_opened, door_closed, door_locked (auto), door_open_timeout (01 §3.4 'eshik ochiq qolishi'), lock_fault (bolt not confirmed), mechanical_key_used (01 §1.4), forced_open (door open without unlock — tamper).

ak_clamp_unlocked/locked, ak_removed/returned (confirmed by ≥2 of pressure/clamp/RFID per 01 §4.3), pm_box_unlocked/locked, pm_removed/returned (RFID), ammo_strap_unlocked/locked, ammo_box_removed/returned (weight+RFID), mag_rack_unlocked/locked, mag_count_changed {n}, item_removed/returned {tag: helmet, armor, gas_mask, handcuffs, bag, body_cam}. 01 §2.5: take/return is recorded by sensors with date, time, officer and weapon serial; on return the system checks that exactly the assigned items are back in place.

impact_detected {g, axis} (accelerometer), tamper_hatch {which}, tamper_attempt, glass_break (only if a glazed variant is ever certified; n/a under 01), power_loss, mains_restored, battery_low, ups_fault, temp_out_of_range, comms_lost/restored, clock_drift. 01 §3.4 'Signal': "Urilish, buzish, eshik ochiq qolishi va quvvat uzilishi".

door {open/closed}, lock {locked/unlocked}, sub_locks {ak_clamp, pm_box, ammo_strap, mag_rack}, presence {ak, pm, mags 0–4, ammo_box, helmet, armor, gas_mask, handcuffs, bag, body_cam}, weights {mag_rack_g, ammo_g}, power {mains, battery_pct, on_ups}, temp_c, heater_on, interior_light, reader_state (idle/face/finger/ok/open/lock/denied/blocked/alarm), mode (normal/blocked/sbor/trevoga/emergency), sensor_health {camera, fingerprint, rfid, accel}, event_queue_depth (offline cache), last_sync_ts, fw_version. 01 §3.4 'Inventar': mavjud / yo'q / nosoz / xizmatda per item.

01 'Loyiha konsepsiyasi': "Markaziy tarmoq uzilganda mahalliy ruxsatlar va jurnal ishlashda davom etadi"; 01 §4.5 "internet bo'lmasa lokal ishlash va keyin sinxronlash"; 01 §4.7 armory level holds "hodisalar keshi". Telemetry must be sequence-numbered and idempotent; server marks events 'received late' and keeps device time + server time.

01 §3.6: ≈4 events per cabinet per day → 20 000/day and ≈7.3 M/year at 5 000 cabinets; text journal small; video/face images stored briefly; tamper video archived separately; biometric templates stored protected; all data on a local server in Uzbekistan.

01 §2.4 'Qurolxona mas'uli': "shkafni biriktiradi va bloklaydi". Command block_cabinet {reason, by_user} / unblock_cabinet; cabinet shows BLOCKED (red) and refuses local auth; logged. Per-item hold: 01 §4.4 "Ko'rik yoki ta'mirdan o'tmagan qurolni qayta berish bloklanadi" → set_item_hold {item, reason}.

01 §2.6: only authorised duty officer, armory keeper or commander; "vakolatli karta + maxsus PIN, zarur holatda ikki mas'ul shaxs tasdig'i"; every emergency opening to a non-erasable separate journal. Command emergency_open {approver1, approver2, scope: door|door+ak|door+pm|all, ttl}; server enforces two approvals before sending; cabinet logs 'favqulodda ochish' (01 §3.4 'Kirish usuli'). 01 §1.4 also requires mechanical emergency lock as last resort.

06 infographic: modes 'Сбор' (assembly) and 'Тревога' (alert) "significantly shorten the arming time of personnel". Command set_mode {sbor|trevoga|normal}: pre-authorises assigned officers' cabinets for a time window (still requiring their own auth, or with commander approval per 01 §2.6). Naming in Uzbek deliverables: 'Yig'ilish' / 'Trevoga' (01 uses 'favqulodda ommaviy ochish').

assign_officer {tabel, name, card_uid, biometric template refs, permissions avtomat/to'pponcha}, set_schedule (01 §2.5 'xizmat navbati, lavozim va amaldagi ruxsat'), temporary authorisation (01 §2.4 navbatchi: "vaqtinchalik vakolat"), set_inventory {item, serial, rfid_tag, slot} (01 §2.3), set_thresholds {door_open_timeout, return_deadline, max_denied_attempts, heater_setpoint}, set_interior_light. Local copy of permissions is mandatory for offline operation.

findings.topic: Time sync, firmware, self-test, inventory scan
findings.detail: time_sync (needed for audit ordering — 01 §2.5 'Sana, vaqt'), firmware_update (signed image; ESP32 OTA per user default), self_test (camera, fingerprint, RFID, locks bolt feedback, battery), request_inventory_scan (RFID sweep, 01 §4.3 'tez inventarizatsiya'), ack_alarm / clear_alarm, display_message {text} (e.g. late-return warning — 01 §4.4).

Commands must be signed/encrypted end-to-end because the module 'only sends an authenticated (encrypted) signal' and relays are inside the cabinet (03). Two-person rule for emergency open is enforced server-side and re-checked by the cabinet (both approver IDs in the command).

findings.topic: Front elevation with 01 zones as the layout grid
findings.detail: Render one cabinet 2000×400 (front) with 01 §1.2 zones: 0–1150 'AK-74 va taktik sumka'; 1150–1450 'O'q-dori qutisi yoki bronjilet'; 1450–1700 'PM, magazinlar, kishan va kichik jihozlar'; 1700–1950 'Dubulg'a va gaz niqobi'; 1950–2000 'Kabel, LED va datchiklar'. 03 shelf heights (z 1293/1553/1812 with floor at z 104 → 1189/1449/1708 mm above floor) map onto these boundaries and can position the slot icons.

findings.topic: Slot cards with presence + lock state
findings.detail: Slots: AK-74 (present via pressure+clamp+RFID; clamp lock), 4× AK magazines (rack lock, weight), ammo box (strap lock, weight, party/calibre/count from 01 §2.3), PM box (lock, PM + 2 mags), helmet 6B47, body armor (bar), gas-mask bag, handcuffs (on belt/hook plate), tactical bag, small kit box, body camera (01 §2.3, not in 03). Each shows: 'mavjud / yo'q / nosoz / xizmatda' (01 §3.4), serial/inventory number, RFID tag, last take/return time.

Door icon: open/closed angle + locked/unlocked + auto-lock pending; reader panel mini-replica: LED bar colour (ko'k/sariq/yashil/qizil), current display text, state chip (idle/face/finger/ok/open/lock + denied/blocked/alarm/offline/emergency). Uses the exact 03 palette hexes.
mains, battery %, on-UPS timer (≈5 h at 20 Ah per 03), module temp + heater, LTE/WAN at armory gateway, last heartbeat, event queue depth (offline), firmware version, tamper status of hatches.

Cabinet number + address + technical state (01 §3.4 'Shkaf'); assigned officer F.I.Sh., tabel raqami, bo'linma, xizmat holati (01 §3.4 'Xodim'); current permissions (avtomat/to'pponcha), block flag, temporary authorisation expiry, return deadline countdown / late flag (01 §3.4 'Kechikish').

findings.topic: Event timeline and journals per cabinet
findings.detail: Chronological list: take/return with duration, access method, denied attempts with reason/count, emergency openings (separate non-erasable journal), alarms, mechanical key use, config changes. Matches 01 §3.4 statistics table and 01 'To'liq audit' principle.

Block/unblock (Qurolxona mas'uli), emergency open with second approver (Navbatchi/komandir), set mode Сбор/Тревога, request inventory scan, self-test, time sync, firmware update (Administrator — who has no weapon-issue rights per 01 §2.4), item hold (not inspected).

03/02: door 11-3 with two windows (260×695 at z 240…935 and 260×910 at z 1165…2075; 44.4 laminate 9.52 mm, EN 356 P4A, 15×15×2 rings, joggled bead) and the cabinet documented as a 'tekshiruv shkafi'. 01 §1.5 warning box: law requires 'seyf yoki metall shkaf'; a glazed outer door risks certification and IIV agreement; safest is a metal outer door and showing the interior via camera/screen. 01 WINS: metal door; META.windows/glass, glazing rings, glass-break sensor and the P6B option become obsolete; interior LED strips may stay for an interior camera.

03/02 gabarit 400 × 646 × 2056 (X×Y×Z), module 200 mm → 600 wide; BOM side wall 2000 × 613.7 × 23 (the 2056 includes the 50 mm plinth and floor at z 104). 01 §1.1: accepted gabarit 2000 × 400 × 600, with module 2000 × 600 × 600; internal width ≈350–360, depth ≈540–560; the old 2056×400×646 came from the SOLIDWORKS model. 01 WINS; all twin geometry and BOM dimensions must be re-based to 2000×400×600.

findings.topic: Full-height electronics module per cabinet vs shared terminal per 10–20 cabinets
findings.detail: 03/02: each cabinet has a 200×623×2056 module with SBC, face processor, 24 V PSU, DC-UPS, LiFePO4, LTE router, reader. 01 §3.3: 'Har bir shkafga to'liq balandlikdagi alohida elektronika moduli qo'yish joy va xarajatni oshiradi. Maqbul variant: 10–20 ta shkafga bitta umumiy Face ID terminali, lokal kontroller va aloqa moduli; har bir shkafda esa qulf, identifikator, datchiklar va arzon mahalliy kontroller.' 01 §4.7 five-level architecture. 01 WINS for the system design; the admin panel must model Terminal and Armory controller as entities distinct from Cabinet, and telemetry carries terminal_id.

findings.topic: Face as primary factor vs card + fingerprint/PIN primary
findings.detail: 03 'Face ID moduli': 'yuz — asosiy omil'; 02 §5.4 scenario 'Yuz tanish → barmoq izi → qulf ochiladi'. 01 §4.2: primary = service card + fingerprint or PIN; Face ID additional; 'Faqat Face IDga tayanish niqob, dubulg'a, yorug'lik va kamera nosozligi sababli tavsiya etilmaydi'. 01 WINS: default flow card → fingerprint/PIN (Face ID optional extra); the 03 state machine gains a 'card' state before 'face'/'finger'.

findings.topic: No card reader / PIN entry in 03 reader
findings.detail: 03 reader = cameras + display + fingerprint + LED; card/PIN only mentioned as a fallback for gloves. 01 requires card + PIN as primary. 01 WINS: add RFID card antenna and PIN input to the reader/terminal.

03 has only a motorised latch/lock box; 01 §1.4 'elektron qulf va favqulodda mexanik qulf' and 'mexanik kalit ishlatilishi alohida qayd qilinadi'; 01 §4.2 emergency = card + special PIN + mechanical key. 01 WINS: add mechanical key cylinder with key-use switch. Consistent with user default fail-secure lock + mechanical key.

findings.topic: LTE router per cabinet vs armory-level gateway
findings.detail: 03: LTE router and antenna in every module. 01 §4.7: network gateway, UPS and event cache at the armory level; 01 §4.6 local IIV server, offline-first. 01 WINS: LTE (if any) is the armory gateway's WAN backup; cabinets talk to the armory controller over the local network.

findings.topic: Body camera missing from 03 equipment list
findings.detail: 03 'Jihozlar (1 askar)': AK-74, bag, belt+holster+handcuffs, armor bar, ammo box + 2 packs, PM box, 4 AK mags, small kit box (fonar, pichoq, tibbiy paket), helmet 6B47, gas-mask bag. 01 §2.3 adds 'Body-kamera — qurilma seriya raqami bilan' and 01 §4.6 lists body camera among tracked items. 01 WINS: add a body-camera slot (sensor/RFID) to the twin and inventory.

findings.topic: Roles: 06 three roles vs 01 five roles
findings.detail: 06: Сотрудник (biometrics + video, own cell only), Оператор (journal of all actions; monitoring and confirmation), Администратор (audit of system edits; technical setup). 01 §2.4: Oddiy xodim, Qurolxona mas'uli, Navbatchi yoki komandir, Administrator (no automatic weapon rights), Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat. 01 WINS; 06's Оператор ≈ Qurolxona mas'uli + Navbatchi.

findings.topic: 'Tekshiruv shkafi' documentation vs certified metal cabinet
findings.detail: 02 §6 / 03: the glazed door takes the cabinet out of GOST R 55148-2012 (= EN 14450) S1–S2 and out of the national 'metall shkaf' requirement, so it must be documented as an inspection cabinet inside a guarded armory. 01 §1.3/§1.5: the product must be a lockable metal cabinet under O'RQ-550 with EN 14450 S1/S2 as target. 01 WINS.

JS comment about '5 slots, 95 mm pitch' rack and old right door 11-2 / shadow slot (RACK.n=1 now); header subtitle 'oynali eshik (44.4 P4A laminat, 2 ta ko'rish oynasi)'; META.removed ['11-2','3-6','5-6','9-7','9-8'] and CLIP data describe the SOLIDWORKS-derived body, which 01 re-bases to 2000×400×600.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.topic: Normal workflow (8 steps) — the reference sequence for firmware and journal
findings.detail: 01 §2.5: (1) officer identified by service card or Face ID; (2) confirmed by fingerprint or PIN; (3) system checks duty roster, position and current permission; (4) only the relevant cabinet opens; (5) removal of weapon/equipment recorded by sensors; (6) date, time, officer and weapon serial written to journal; (7) on return, exactly the assigned items must be back in place; (8) door closes, cabinet auto-locks.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.detail: 01 'Loyiha konsepsiyasi': 'Ikki bosqichli tasdiqlash — Xizmat kartasi va biometrika/PIN orqali shaxs hamda vakolat tekshiriladi'; access right includes 'xizmat holati' (service status) — so the server/armory controller must push officer status (on duty, suspended, on leave) to the local permission cache.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.topic: Late return alert and return validation
findings.detail: 01 §4.4: 'Kech qaytarilganda mas'ul shaxsga signal yuboriladi'; 'Qaytarishda aynan tegishli qurol tekshiriladi'; 01 §3.4 'Kechikish: belgilangan vaqtda qaytarilmagan jihoz'. Server-computed late flag per item; mismatch on return (wrong RFID) → event return_mismatch.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.topic: Independent monitoring of weapon and ammunition state
findings.detail: 01 §1.4: 'Qurol va o'q-dori holati mustaqil nazorat qilinadi' — separate sensor channels for AK, PM, magazines and ammo box; matches 03's two separate permissions and separate solenoids.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.topic: Management dashboard KPIs fed by cabinet telemetry
findings.detail: 01 §3.5: total and available weapons; weapons currently issued; not returned on time; faulty or blocked cabinets; daily take/returns; denied access attempts; emergency openings; inventory discrepancies; status by region and unit. Each maps directly to the telemetry events/state above.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.detail: 01 §1.2: shelves and holders are removable or height-adjustable so one base body serves different positions/kits — the twin's slot layout must be configurable per cabinet (slot template), not hard-coded to the 03 layout.

findings.section: J. 01 requirements binding the device interface
findings.detail: 01 §4.5: API integration with existing HR, duty-roster and access-control systems; 01 §4.6: integration with the existing service card and internal databases. Officer profiles and duty rosters are imported, not entered by hand.

findings.topic: Hardware cell control synced with video
findings.detail: 'Аппаратный контроль ячеек: каждое открытие и наличие оружия фиксируется датчиками и синхронизируется с видеозаписью' — every opening and weapon presence recorded by sensors and synchronised with video. Combined with 01 §1.5 ('ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko'rsatish') and 01 §3.6 video retention rules, the twin should link each event to a video clip (armory CCTV or interior camera).

'Принцип Fail-secure и цифровой аудит: при сбое питания ячейки остаются заблокированными, а все действия пишутся в неизменяемый журнал'. Consistent with 01 'o'chirib bo'lmaydigan audit jurnali' (§4.5) and the user default fail-secure lock + mechanical key.

'Мониторинг готовности 24/7: командование в реальном времени видит точную статистику: кто из сотрудников вооружен, а кто — нет' — a live 'armed / not armed' roster is a required dashboard widget derived from weapon_issued/returned events.

findings.topic: Shared terminal shown in the concept art
findings.detail: The locker bank in 06 has small per-cell readers plus one central terminal column with a large screen — matching 01 §3.3/§4.7 (one Face ID terminal per 10–20 cabinets), not 03's full-height module per cabinet.

findings.section: L. Numeric reference (03) for twin visuals
findings.topic: Item coordinates in 03 (viewer frame: +X left, +Y front, Z up, floor z 104)
findings.detail: AK-74 upright: centre x −273, bore y −140, butt cradle z 180…215, muzzle z 1158, clamp z 965…995; bag x −200…−5, z 180…630; belt/holster/cuffs on hook plate x 13.6, z 880…1270; armor bar Ø20 z 1220…1240; ammo box x −325…−85, z 1296…1425; PM box x −325…−125, z 1556…1616; mag rack x −150…−25 (mags z 1561…1766); kit box x −325…−165; helmet centre (−170, 30, 1901), ring Ø200; gas-mask bag x −300…−20, z 1815…2005; LED strips z 1281 and z 2140; reader x −519…−399, z 1340…1600. Use only as relative layout; absolute heights shift when re-based to 01's 2000 mm body.

findings.detail: Lift 15 mm, pull 30 mm forward (+y), tilt 30° (JS −0.5236 rad; aside says ≥25°), only with door ≥90°; muzzle crosses the door plane at z ≈1117. Useful for an animated 'issue' state in the twin.

contradictions.issue: Outer door: glazed (two 44.4 P4A windows) vs solid metal
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — metal door. Drop glass-break sensor, glazing rings, P6B option and the 'tekshiruv shkafi' documentation route; keep accelerometer as impact/tamper sensor; show interior via camera/screen per 01 §1.5.

contradictions.issue: Cabinet dimensions 2056×400×646 (module → 600 wide) vs 2000×400×600 (module → 2000×600×600)
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — 2000×400×600; all 03 z-coordinates (floor at z 104, plinth 50) must be re-based; twin uses 01 zones 0–1150/1150–1450/1450–1700/1700–1950/1950–2000.

contradictions.issue: Full-height electronics module (SBC, face processor, PSU, DC-UPS, LiFePO4, LTE router) per cabinet vs one shared Face ID terminal + local controller per 10–20 cabinets and cheap ESP32/STM32 per cabinet
contradictions.sources: 03 aside 'Modul korpusi'/'Ichki joy', 02 §5.4 vs 01 §3.3, §4.7 (note 01 §1.1 still lists a 150–200 mm module in the accepted gabarit)
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins for the system architecture: admin panel models Cabinet, Terminal, Armory controller and Server as separate entities; the prototype (1–2 units) may physically carry a module, but software must support terminal_id ≠ cabinet_id. Resolve the 01 §1.1 vs §3.3 tension as: module gabarit reserved, content minimised (lock, ID, sensors, ESP32).

contradictions.issue: Primary identification factor: face ('yuz — asosiy omil', flow face → finger) vs service card + fingerprint or PIN, Face ID only additional
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — flow: card → fingerprint/PIN (Face ID optional); 03 state machine gains a 'card' state; reader gets an RFID antenna and PIN input.

contradictions.issue: Main door lock has no mechanical override in 03 (motorised latch only) vs 01 requires electronic lock + emergency mechanical lock with logged key use
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — add key cylinder + key-use switch; fail-secure by default (06, user default).

contradictions.issue: LTE router and antenna in every cabinet module vs network gateway/UPS/event cache at armory level with local IIV server
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — LTE only as armory-gateway WAN backup; cabinets on local network to the armory controller.

contradictions.issue: Equipment list omits body camera (03) vs body camera tracked by serial (01)
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — add body-camera slot and inventory item.

contradictions.issue: Roles: three (Сотрудник/Оператор/Администратор) vs five (Oddiy xodim, Qurolxona mas'uli, Navbatchi/komandir, Administrator, Tekshiruvchi/rahbariyat)
contradictions.resolution: 01 wins — five roles; Administrator has no weapon-issue rights.

contradictions.issue: 03 state machine has no denied / blocked / alarm / offline / emergency states, while 01 requires denied-attempt logging (who, when, reason, count), remote blocking, alarms and emergency openings
contradictions.resolution: Extend firmware/twin states beyond 03: card, denied, blocked, alarm, offline, emergency_open, sbor/trevoga mode, late-return; keep 03's Uzbek texts and LED colours for the existing states.

gaps: PIN entry hardware is not specified anywhere (03 display is 3.5" and not stated as touch; no keypad). Default a competent engineer can pick: 12-key sealed keypad on the terminal (or touch display) — no need to ask.
RFID service-card technology (125 kHz vs 13.56 MHz MIFARE/DESFire) depends on the existing IIV card — 01 §5.1 already lists it as a pre-TZ question to the customer; do not re-ask the user.

Magazine-rack lid lock actuator and per-slot magazine sensing are not specified in 03 (only 'qulflanadigan qopqoq'); default: one solenoid released with the 'avtomat' permission + weight sensor for the 4 slots (01 §4.3).
Body-camera slot: 01 requires tracking by serial but no source specifies a slot, sensor or charging dock; default: RFID-tagged dock in the 1450–1700 zone, no charging in the prototype.

Interior camera for 'ichki holatni kamera/ekranda ko'rsatish' (01 §1.5) and 06's 'synchronised with video' have no resolution/storage/trigger spec; default: armory CCTV linked by timestamp, optional per-cabinet interior camera triggered on unlock; retention per 01 §3.6 (short for normal access, archived for tamper).

Threshold values are absent from all sources: door-open timeout, late-return deadline rule, max denied attempts before temporary block, battery-low level, impact g-threshold; defaults: door open > 5 min warning, return deadline = shift end + 30 min, 3 denied attempts → 15 min local block + alert, battery < 20 %, impact > 2 g.

Cabinet↔armory-controller protocol (ESP32 ↔ Raspberry Pi) is not defined in any source; default: MQTT over wired Ethernet/RS-485 with signed messages, sequence numbers and offline queue — consistent with 03's 'authenticated signal' rule.
Scope of an emergency/mass open (door only vs all sub-locks) is not stated; 01 §2.6 says 'favqulodda ommaviy ochish'; default: door + all sub-locks in sequence, with two approvers recorded.

Whether each cabinet keeps its own small display/LED under the shared-terminal architecture (01 §4.7 gives the terminal the screen, the cabinet an 'identifikator'); default: per-cabinet RGB status LED + door lock only; texts shown on the shared terminal.

Backup-power sizing per cabinet under the shared architecture (03's 20 Ah LiFePO4 ≈5 h was per full module); 01 gives no duration; default: armory UPS + small per-cabinet backup sufficient for lock/sensors/event cache for ≥4 h.
